To address these limitations, we present a personalised digital twin framework for AD prediction and scenario-based analysis using multimodal longitudinal data. The proposed approach integrates complementary modelling strategies to capture clinical transitions and temporal dependencies across visits. Using data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), including cognitive assessments, clinical variables, and MRI-derived phenotypes, the framework predicts cognitive status and diagnostic categories while quantifying predictive uncertainty and enabling patient-specific what-if trajectory analysis. Evaluation on leak-free subject-level splits demonstrates strong performance in score forecasting and diagnosis classification. In this sparse and irregular ADNI setting, transition-based modelling of adjacent visits achieved higher predictive accuracy than the sequence-based branch, suggesting that local transition modelling may be more data-efficient. While sequence models remain valuable for uncertainty-aware trajectory forecasting, local transition modelling offers a more data-efficient and robust predictive strategy. These findings highlight the importance of aligning temporal modelling strategies with clinical data structure and suggest that transition-based digital twin formulations may provide a practical and interpretable approach for personalised disease forecasting in neurodegenerative disorders.

</details>


### [265] [When Do Local Score Models Extrapolate Across Size? A Diagnostic Theory and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09705)
*Wenjie Xi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了科学生成模型中尺寸迁移稳定性的关键因素是高斯平滑得分的准局部性，而非单纯的架构局部性，并提出了理论保证和诊断基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学生成建模常需要将在小系统上训练的模型迁移到大系统进行评估，但现有的平移不变架构虽然具备局部性，却无法保证稳定的尺寸外推。作者旨在探究究竟什么因素决定了稳定的尺寸迁移能力。

Method: 通过Tweedie公式理论分析高斯平滑得分的性质，证明局部边缘分布的尺寸一致比较定理；同时提出有限深度局部流（FDLF）白盒诊断基准，该基准具有精确的得分、密度和可控的响应范围，用于验证理论发现。

Result: 实验验证了空间混合、平滑得分准局部性与模型感受野之间的相互作用关系。在强空间混合条件下，平滑得分相对于感受野保持准局部性，实现稳定外推；当空间混合减弱时，得分的局部性快速退化，导致尺寸迁移失败。远距离扰动可通过后验协方差影响局部得分分量。

Conclusion: 稳定的尺寸外推由高斯平滑得分的准局部性控制，而非架构局部性本身。局部模型成功的前提是其感受野能够覆盖平滑得分的响应范围，这一发现为科学生成模型的尺寸迁移提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Scientific generative modeling often requires size transfer, where models trained on small systems are evaluated on larger ones. While translation-invariant architectures enable this evaluation, we show that architectural locality alone does not guarantee stable size extrapolation. Instead, stable extrapolation is governed by the quasi-locality of the Gaussian-smoothed score. Through Tweedie's formula, far-away perturbations can influence local score components via posterior covariance, meaning a local model succeeds only if its receptive field covers the smoothed score's response range. We formalize this mechanism, proving a size-uniform comparison theorem for local marginals under reverse diffusion. We also introduce Finite-Depth Local Flow (FDLF), a white-box diagnostic benchmark with exact scores, densities, and controllable response ranges. Empirically, we validate the interplay between spatial mixing, smoothed-score quasi-locality, and model receptive fields. Under spatial mixing, the smoothed score remains quasi-local relative to the receptive field, enabling stable extrapolation. Conversely, when spatial mixing weakens, the score's locality rapidly degrades, causing size transfer to fail.

</details>


### [266] [BrainSurgery: Reproducible and Reliable Declarative Weight Manipulations for Model Editing and Upcycling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09707)
*Gianluca Barmina,Annemette Broch Pirchert,Andrea Blasi Núñez,Lukas Galke Poech,Peter Schneider-Kamp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了BrainSurgery，一个用于神经网络检查点“张量手术”的工具，通过声明式YAML计划实现稳健、可复现的复杂权重变换，支持结构修改、数学变换和张量重塑，并通过内置断言防止静默错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着深度学习模型规模扩大，管理和修改大型检查点变得日益困难。研究人员常需对模型权重进行层重组、精度转换、低秩分解和架构调试，但现有工作流依赖于脆弱的临时Python脚本，缺乏稳健性和可复现性。

Method: BrainSurgery通过抽象存储格式和内存管理，使用声明式YAML计划执行复杂变换。支持通过表达性正则表达式和结构定位进行结构修改、数学变换和张量重塑，并内置断言验证张量形状、数据类型和数值以防止静默错误。

Result: 系统演示涵盖四个示例和三个案例研究（从模型升级到LoRA提取），展示了BrainSurgery在模型权重变换任务中的实用性和有效性。

Conclusion: BrainSurgery为未来研究提供了稳健基础，通过其可复现和验证过的操作，有望成为神经网络检查点管理的标准工具。

Abstract: As deep learning models scale, managing, inspecting, and modifying large checkpoints has become increasingly challenging. Researchers often need to alter model weights for layer restructuring, precision casting, low-rank factorization, and architectural debugging, yet these workflows often rely on fragile ad-hoc Python scripts. Here, we introduce BrainSurgery, a tool for robust and reproducible "tensor surgery" on neural network checkpoints, and provide a system demonstration covering four examples and three case studies from model upcycling to LoRA extraction. By abstracting storage formats and memory management, BrainSurgery executes complex transformations through declarative YAML plans. It supports structural modifications, mathematical transformations, and tensor reshaping through expressive regex and structural targeting, while built-in assertions validate tensor shapes, data types, and values to prevent silent errors. We envision that BrainSurgery will provide a strong foundation for future research through its reproducible and validated operations.

</details>


### [267] [Evaluating the Representation Space of Diffusion Models via Self-Supervised Principles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09718)
*Xiao Li,Yixuan Jia,Zekai Zhang,Xiang Li,Lianghe Shi,Jinxin Zhou,Zhihui Zhu,Liyue Shen,Qing Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了不变性污染比率（ICR）这一新指标，用于联合评估扩散模型的表示学习和生成能力。研究发现：表示能力在中等噪声水平达到最优；ICR可作为训练过程中从泛化转向记忆化的早期检测指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在生成任务和自监督表示学习方面均表现出色，但这两个能力之间的内在联系尚未得到充分探索。现有研究缺乏统一框架来同时理解和评估扩散模型的表示与生成特性。

Method: 1. 借鉴自监督学习思想，将特征分解为不变成分和残差成分；
2. 提出基于Fisher判别的不变性污染比率（ICR）指标，量化残差变化对不变信号的污染程度；
3. 利用该框架分析扩散模型在不同噪声水平下的判别性表现；
4. 通过监控ICR指标变化研究数据受限情况下模型从泛化到记忆化的转变过程。

Result: 在表示学习方面：模型的不变性在中等噪声水平达到峰值，该噪声水平下下游分类任务性能最优；在生成能力方面：发现训练过程存在从真正泛化到记忆化的转变，ICR可作为敏感的早期学习指示器，Fisher方向上残差能量的增加标志着记忆化的开始，该指标仅需训练特征即可检测，无需外部评估器或留出测试集。

Conclusion: 扩散模型可以通过其学习表示的几何特性从自监督视角进行监控和理解。ICR框架成功揭示了扩散模型表示能力与生成能力之间的联系，为理解模型训练动态提供了新视角，并提供了实用的训练监控方法。

Abstract: Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable generative capabilities and have also emerged as powerful self-supervised representation learners, yet the connection between these two abilities remains less explored. Drawing inspiration from self-supervised learning (SSL), we introduce a framework for jointly evaluating the representation and generation capabilities of diffusion models. Specifically, we decompose features into invariant and residual components and derive the Invariant Contamination Ratio (ICR), a Fisher-based metric that quantifies how residual variation contaminates invariant signal in feature space. We use this framework to analyze both discriminative and generative behavior of diffusion models. On the representation side, we find that invariance peaks at intermediate noise levels, which also yield the best downstream classification performance. On the generative side, we study how training transitions from genuine generalization to memorization in data-limited regimes, and show that ICR serves as a sensitive training-time indicator of early learning: increasing residual energy along Fisher directions marks the onset of memorization, detectable from training features alone without external evaluators or held-out test sets. Overall, our results show that diffusion models can be monitored from a self-supervised perspective through the geometry of their learned representations.

</details>


### [268] [Disentanglement with Holographic Reduced Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09725)
*Jhonny J. Velasquez Olivera,Christo K. Thomas,Walid Saad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于全息约简表示（HRR）的无监督解缠算法，将解缠表示视为符号结构，通过HRR解绑操作提供归纳偏置来实现因子分离，并在理论和实验上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解缠（将数据中的变化因子分离）是机器学习中的长期挑战。现有方法主要依赖变分自编码器和生成对抗网络，采用连续表示。本文受概念间组合关系的启发，提出将解缠表示视为符号结构，但如何在保持可微性的同时学习离散符号结构是一个难题。

Method: 提出一种使用全息约简表示（HRR）的无监督学习算法。核心利用HRR解绑（unbinding）操作作为归纳偏置来分离因子。与标准自编码器不同，该方法的潜在单元是向量求和的形式，而非低维潜在向量的标量维度。同时进行了信息论分析，推导了每槽容量界限。

Result: 实验表明：1）HRR解绑操作能诱导近似独立的符号-值对；2）在潜在遍历和解缠度量上与基线方法相比具有竞争力；3）推导出的每槽容量界限量化了可靠编码的符号概念数量；4）HRR表示比其他解缠表示对噪声更鲁棒，在一系列信噪比下保持重建质量。

Conclusion: 该方法为神经解缠提供了新的视角，通过符号结构和HRR的归纳偏置实现了有效的因子分离，在理论和实验上都得到了验证，证明了其在解缠任务中的潜力。

Abstract: Disentanglement, the separation of factors of variation in data using neural networks, remains a long-standing challenge in machine learning. Prior work has addressed this problem with variational autoencoders and generative adversarial networks that incorporate ideas from variational inference and information-theoretic constraints. In contrast to methods that rely on continuous representations, we propose a design that treats disentangled representations as symbolic structures, motivated by the compositional relationships among the concepts that make up samples from a distribution. However, learning discrete symbolic structures with neural networks while maintaining differentiability is difficult and often requires complex architectures. To address this, we introduce an unsupervised learning algorithm that uses holographic reduced representations (HRR) for neural disentanglement. We show that the HRR unbinding operation provides an inductive bias for separating factors and yields competitive results against baselines, as measured by latent traversals and disentanglement metrics. We complement these empirical findings with an information-theoretic analysis of the HRR unbinding channel. We prove that unbinding induces approximately independent symbol-value pairs and derive a per-slot capacity bound that quantifies how many distinct symbolic concepts can be reliably encoded, giving a quantitative account of the inductive bias toward disentanglement. The resulting representations differ from standard autoencoder-based models, in that their latent units are vectors that are summed together, rather than scalar dimensions of a low-dimensional latent vector. We show that this HRR representation is more robust to noise than other disentangled representations and maintains reconstruction quality across a range of SNRs.

</details>


### [269] [Tight Sample Complexity of Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09731)
*Chenxiao Yang,Nathan Srebro,Zhiyuan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文精确刻画了深度为L、参数总量为W的Transformer的VC维，以及使用该Transformer进行链式思维(Chain-of-Thought)学习的样本复杂度，给出了上界和几乎匹配的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解Transformer模型的理论性质是机器学习理论的核心问题之一。VC维是衡量模型表达能力的关键指标，而链式思维学习是近期大语言模型展现出的重要能力。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，为Transformer的理论基础提供严格的数学刻画。

Method: 针对输入序列长度为T、输出单个值的深度L Transformers，作者通过理论分析建立了VC维的上界O(LW log(TW))和下界Ω(LW log(TW/L))。对于链式思维学习，作者分析了教师强制(teacher forcing)方法的样本复杂度，其中T'为自回归步数，T为输入长度。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) VC维的上界O(LW log(TW))和几乎匹配的下界Ω(LW log(TW/L))；(2) 链式思维学习的样本复杂度上界O(LW log((T+T')W))和下界Ω(LW log((T+T')W/L))，证明了教师强制方法在该设置下的最优性。

Conclusion: 本文首次对Transformer的VC维和链式思维学习的样本复杂度给出了紧密的理论刻画，上下界几乎匹配，相差仅一个L的因子。这为理解Transformer的表达能力和学习理论提供了重要基础，也证明了基于链式思维数据的学习方法的理论最优性。

Abstract: We tightly characterize the VC dimension of depth-$L$ Transformers with a total of $W$ parameters, mapping an input sequence of length $T$ to a single output, establishing an upper bound of $O(L W \log (T W))$ and a nearly matching lower bound of $Ω(L W \log (T W / L))$. We further tightly characterize the sample complexity of chain-of-thought learning using such a Transformer, showing teacher forcing (i.e. selecting a predictor consistent with the entire chain-of-thought on training data) learns with sample complexity $O\left(L W \log \left(\left(T+T^{\prime}\right) W\right)\right)$ and that any learning rule that uses chain-of-thought data requires at least $Ω\left(L W \log \left(\left(T+T^{\prime}\right) W / L\right)\right)$ examples, where $T$ is the input length and $T^{\prime}$ is the number of autoregressive steps.

</details>


### [270] [Learning Dynamics Reveal a Hierarchy of Weight-Induced Layerwise Gram Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09744)
*Claudio Nordio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将前馈ReLU网络梯度下降的权重空间动力学重写为训练集空间上的场动力学，揭示了由输入几何矩阵和动态共激活矩阵因式分解的集体核所支配的残差动力学，深度网络需引入权重诱导的Gram算子层级来实现跨层信息传输的闭合方程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经网络训练分析主要关注权重空间的动力学，但权重维度高且难以解释。作者希望找到一种新的视角，将梯度下降动力学转化为在训练集空间上定义的场的集体动力学，从而获得更紧凑、可解释的动力学描述。

Method: 针对具有固定读出层和二次损失的前馈ReLU网络，作者推导梯度下降方程，并通过消除权重变量得到关于残差的闭合方程。对于单隐藏层网络，激活动力学中的权重变量可被消去，得到由输入几何矩阵和动态共激活矩阵因式分解形成的集体核控制的残差方程；对于更深层网络，推导逐层核结构动力学，分析从第三层开始需要的权重诱导Gram算子层级。

Result: 单隐藏层ReLU网络的残差动力学由一个集体核控制，该核可因式分解为输入几何矩阵和动态共激活矩阵的乘积。更深层网络的残差动力学保持清晰的逐层核结构，但从第三层开始，动力学闭合需要引入权重诱导的Gram算子层级来协调跨层信息传输。

Conclusion: 梯度下降可重新表述为训练集空间上的闭合场动力学而非权重空间动力学。单隐藏层动力学简洁，由集体核控制；深层网络逐层核结构清晰，但深度增加时需要更复杂的Gram算子层级结构来实现动力学闭合，揭示了深度网络中跨层信息传输的机制。

Abstract: We study feed-forward ReLU networks with fixed readout and quadratic loss. The aim is to rewrite gradient descent not primarily as a dynamics in weight space, but as a collective dynamics closed in terms of fields defined on the training-set space. For a single hidden layer, the weight variables can be eliminated from the activation dynamics, yielding a closed equation for the residuals governed by a collective kernel that factorizes into an input-geometric matrix and a dynamical co-activation matrix. For deeper networks, the residual dynamics retains a clean layer-wise kernel structure. However, from depth three onward, closure requires a hierarchy of weight-induced Gram operators that mediate information transport across layers.

</details>


### [271] [Perturbative Contrastive Physical Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09756)
*Kyungeun Kim,Amanuel Anteneh,Israel Klich,Olivier Pfister,J. M. Schwarz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了微扰对比物理学习（PCPL）框架，通过对比物理系统在受控变化下的响应差异来实现学习，无需中心化梯度计算，在弹簧网络和连续变量光子电路中成功实现了分类和模拟乘法任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统物理学习系统通常需要外部处理器或显式反向传播算法来计算梯度，这限制了物理系统的自主性和可扩展性。本文旨在开发一种无需中心化梯度计算的学习框架，利用物理系统自身的响应特性来实现学习，从而构建更加自主的物理学习系统。

Method: 提出微扰对比物理学习（PCPL）框架，核心思想是通过控制输入、边界条件、参数或解释函数的变化，产生可测量的物理状态对比。这些对比驱动的更新可以反映局部敏感性或全局逆问题结构，而有效学习几何则从系统自身的物理响应中隐式涌现。该方法统一并扩展了平衡传播（基于能量系统中自由平衡和微扰平衡的对比）和频率传播（从正弦驱动、频率解调响应中提取对比）等先前方法。

Result: 在两个物理平台上验证了PCPL框架：(1) 弹簧网络：利用测量的位移和力来更新键刚度，成功学习分类任务；(2) 连续变量光子电路：通过x正交测量和雅可比矩阵的有限差分估计进行训练，成功实现分类任务，并进一步训练实现了模拟乘法功能。

Conclusion: PCPL框架证明了学习行为可以在没有外部处理器或显式反向传播的情况下，从物理系统自身的响应中涌现。该框架成功统一了现有的物理学习方法，为构建更加自主的物理学习系统提供了理论基础和实践验证，展现了物理智能计算的潜力。

Abstract: Responses to perturbations are key to understanding physical systems. The ability to contrast such responses by comparing how a system reacts under slightly different conditions provides a mechanism for learning. Here, we introduce Perturbative Contrastive Physical Learning (PCPL), a general framework in which learning emerges from measurable contrasts between physical states produced by controlled changes to inputs, boundary conditions, parameters, or interpreter functions. PCPL unifies and extends prior approaches: Equilibrium Propagation is rooted in contrasts between free and nudged equilibria in energy-based systems, while Frequency Propagation corresponds to contrasts extracted from sinusoidally driven, frequency-demodulated responses. We show that contrast-driven updates can reflect either local sensitivities or global inverse-problem structure, yet do not require centralized gradient computation. Instead, effective learning geometry emerges implicitly from the system's own physical response, allowing learning behavior to arise without an external processor or explicit backpropagation. We demonstrate PCPL in two platforms: (i) spring networks that update bond stiffness using measured displacements and forces, and (ii) continuous-variable photonic circuits trained via x quadrature measurements and finite-difference estimates of the Jacobian. Both platforms successfully learn classification tasks. We further show that a continuous-variable photonic circuit can be trained to implement analog multiplication, illustrating a step toward more autonomous physical learning systems.

</details>


### [272] [Preserving Plasticity in Continual Learning via Dynamical Isometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09762)
*Andries Rosseau,Robert Müller,Ann Nowé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对持续学习中神经网络逐渐丧失可塑性的问题，提出基于动态等距性的解决方案，包括新的正则化方法和AdamO优化器，有效维持网络学习能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在非平稳环境下持续训练深度神经网络会导致渐进式可塑性丧失，最终限制进一步学习。现有方法缺乏对可塑性维持机制的深入理解，需要找到更有效的解决方案。

Method: 1) 将可塑性与经验神经正切核相关联，识别动态等距性（层间雅可比奇异值接近1）作为维持可塑性的关键机制；2) 验证近乎动态等距性与非线性表达能力兼容；3) 提出高效的等距性促进正则化方案，激活休眠ReLU单元；4) 开发AdamO优化器，将等距性正则化与梯度更新解耦；5) 从动态等距性视角重新解释现有方法。

Result: 在设计和监督强化学习持续学习基准测试中，所提出的方法一致性地匹配或超越现有方法，有效应对可塑性丧失问题。现有方法仅针对部分等距性度量。

Conclusion: 动态等距性是维持持续学习可塑性的关键机制，通过等距性促进正则化和AdamO优化器可以有效解决可塑性丧失问题，同时保持网络的非线性表达能力。

Abstract: Continual training of deep neural networks under non-stationarity often leads to a progressive loss of plasticity, eventually limiting further learning. We relate plasticity to the empirical Neural Tangent Kernel, and identify dynamical isometry (the condition that layer-wise Jacobian singular values remain close to one) as a key mechanism for preserving plasticity in continual learning. We revisit a class of networks that are almost-everywhere isometric while remaining universal Lipschitz function approximators, demonstrating that near-dynamical isometry is compatible with expressive nonlinear representations. For general architectures, we propose an efficient isometry-promoting regularization scheme and identify a novel mechanism by which it can reactivate dormant ReLU units. Building on this, we introduce AdamO, an Adam-style adaptive optimizer that decouples isometry regularization from gradient updates, analogous to AdamW. We further reinterpret prior plasticity-preserving approaches through the lens of dynamical isometry, showing that they target only a partial measure of isometry. Across supervised and reinforcement-learning continual-learning benchmarks designed to induce plasticity loss, our methods consistently match or outperform existing approaches.

</details>


### [273] [iOSWorld: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Phone Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09764)
*Lawrence Keunho Jang,Mareks Woodside,Geronimo Carom,Andrew Keunwoo Jang,Jing Yu Koh,Ruslan Salakhutdinov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文推出了iOSWorld，这是首个围绕持久用户身份构建的交互式原生iOS模拟器基准测试，包含26个新构建的iOS应用和133项任务，覆盖单应用、多应用以及记忆与个性化三类任务，旨在评估移动代理在个性化场景下的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的移动代理基准测试缺乏个性化能力，无法让代理基于用户的身份、历史和偏好进行推理，而一个有用的手机代理应当具备个人智能，能够跨越应用处理用户的个人数据。

Method: 构建了一个原生iOS模拟器基准iOSWorld，包含26个新构建的iOS应用，应用之间存在交易、消息、旅行记录、社交关系和金融活动等关联数据。设计了133项任务，分为三类：单应用任务（27项）、多应用任务（60项，涉及2-8个应用）以及记忆与个性化任务（46项，需要代理从个人数据中推断模式）。在仅视觉和特权视觉+XML两种设置下评估了前沿和开源的计算机使用模型。

Result: 最佳配置总体准确率为52%，但在多应用任务上仅为37%。特权视觉+XML访问使前沿模型性能提升多达26个百分点，而较小模型未能从添加的可访问性树输入中获益。

Conclusion: iOSWorld填补了移动代理个性化能力评估的空白，揭示了当前模型在多应用任务上的不足，并展示了特权输入对不同规模模型的差异化影响。基准已开源，包含所有应用、种子数据、任务、评分标准和评估代码，为未来研究提供了基础。

Abstract: A useful phone agent needs to be personally intelligent. It should reason over a user's identity, history, and preferences as they exist on the device, not just follow isolated instructions in an impersonal sandbox. Existing mobile agent benchmarks lack this kind of personalization. We introduce iOSWorld, the first interactive native iOS simulator benchmark built around a persistent user identity spanning 26 newly built iOS apps. These apps contain connected data such as transactions, messages, travel records, social relationships, and financial activity. iOSWorld includes 133 tasks across three increasingly difficult categories. Single-app tasks (27) test one app, multi-app tasks (60) span 2 to 8 apps, and memory and personalization tasks (46) require agents to infer patterns from personal data. We evaluate frontier and open-source computer-use models in both vision-only and privileged vision+XML settings. The best configuration reaches 52\% overall but only 37\% on multi-app tasks. Privileged vision+XML access improves frontier models by up to 26 percentage points, while smaller models do not benefit from added accessibility-tree input. We release iOSWorld as an open-source benchmark with all apps, seeded data, tasks, rubrics, and evaluation code.

</details>


### [274] [Bandits for Efficient Experimentation: Adapting to Control Group, Preferences, and Context Drifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09802)
*Udvas Das,Waris Radji,Debabrota Basu,Odalric-Ambrym Maillard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Dri-MED算法，用于解决具有漂移上下文分布和个性化偏好的线性上下文随机多臂老虎机问题，在非平稳异方差噪声下实现了优越的遗憾和约束违反性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在线性上下文随机多臂老虎机设置中，当存在一组用户（各有个性化偏好向量）且上下文分布随时间漂移时，如何在保证每个决策的平均奖励超过基线策略的情况下进行学习。这一设置更贴近实际应用场景，但现有方法难以处理非平稳性和异方差噪声的复合挑战。

Method: 首先将原始问题转化为具有平稳均值但存在异方差和非平稳噪声的线性老虎机问题；然后提出Dri-MED算法，该算法借鉴MED（Minimum Empirical Divergence）策略的线性版本，并针对异方差回归进行细致的方差感知处理，以应对非平稳异方差噪声的挑战。

Result: Dri-MED算法的实例依赖遗憾上界为$\tilde{\mathcal O}\left(\fracκ{\tildeΔ}d^2\log(T)\right)$，其中$\tildeΔ$为约束感知的次优间隙，$κ$为方差感知乘积项；同时算法的期望约束违反量为$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d)$。数值实验表明Dri-MED显著优于忽略漂移和偏好结构的保守基线方法。

Conclusion: Dri-MED算法成功解决了漂移上下文分布和个性化偏好设置下的线性上下文老虎机问题，在保证约束满足的同时实现了优越的遗憾性能，证明了考虑非平稳异方差噪声结构的重要性。

Abstract: We consider a variant of the linear contextual stochastic multi-armed bandits, where the learner must provide recommendations to a group of users, each having its personalized preference vector, and in the presence of context distributions that are drifting over time. Under practitioner-friendly assumptions, we reduce this setting to linear bandit with stationary mean but heteroskedastic and non-stationary noise. We further study the case when the learner must ensure the mean reward of each decision must exceed that of a baseline strategy $\boldsymbolπ_0$ at each decision step. We introduce Dri-MED, an algorithm inspired from the linear version of the MED strategy, and carefully adapted to handle the non-stationary heteroskedastic noise. We show that the instance-dependent regret scales as $\tilde{\mathcal O}\left(\fracκ{\tildeΔ}d^2(\log(T)\right)$, where $\tildeΔ$ is the constraint-aware sub-optimality gap subject to policy $π_0$, with variance-aware multiplicative term $κ$ that we carefully handle using heteroskedastic regression. We further show Dri-MED enjoys $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d)$ expected constraint violations. Our numerical results suggest that Dri-MED significantly outperforms conservative baselines that ignores the drift and preference structure.

</details>


### [275] [Topological Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09806)
*Lennart Bastian,Samuel Leventhal,Mustafa Hajij,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了拓扑神经算子(TNOs)框架，将神经算子从点/边函数推广到拓扑域(胞腔复形)，通过离散外微积分实现跨维度耦合，并进一步提出层次化TNOs以传播长程信息，在PDE基准测试中提升了精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子主要处理点或边上的函数，缺乏对高维拓扑结构的显式建模能力。物理问题中的量通常定义在不同维度的胞腔(点、边、面、体)上，且存在内在的守恒和兼容性结构。需要一种能够原生支持跨维度交互、尊重几何支撑并暴露物理结构的算子学习框架。

Method: 1) 将数据表示为定义在不同维度胞腔上的特征；2) 利用离散外微积分(DE C)中的梯度、旋度、散度型算子实现跨维度耦合；3) 核心设计原则：解耦信息流向(由固定拓扑算子控制)与信息变换(可学习部分)；4) 提出层次化TNOs(HTNOs)，引入可学习的粗糙复形来传播长程和拓扑依赖信息。该框架将现有神经算子统一为特例。

Result: 在包括不规则几何流动问题在内的多个PDE基准测试中，TNOs和HTNOs相比现有方法提升了预测精度。控制实验验证了原生高阶结构和拓扑结构带来的具体收益。框架提供了跨离散化的算子学习统一视角。

Conclusion: TNOs成功将神经算子推广到拓扑域，通过离散外微积分实现了物理一致的跨维度信息交互，同时保留了守恒和兼容性结构。该框架为物理问题中的算子学习提供了更通用、更符合几何物理原理的解决方案。

Abstract: We introduce Topological Neural Operators (TNOs), a principled framework for operator learning on cell complexes that lifts neural operators (NOs) from functions on points and/or edges to topological domains. TNOs represent data as features defined on cells of varying dimension and model their interactions through Discrete Exterior Calculus, enabling explicit cross-dimensional coupling via gradient-, curl-, and divergence-type operators. The key design principle is to decouple where information flows, as governed by fixed topological operators, from how it is transformed (which is learned), yielding models that respect the geometric support of physical quantities and expose conservation and compatibility structure. We further propose Hierarchical TNOs (HTNOs), which incorporate learned coarse complexes to propagate long-range and topology-dependent information. Our framework subsumes existing NOs as a special case, providing a unified perspective on operator learning across discretizations. Across a range of PDE benchmarks, including irregular-geometry flow problems, TNOs and HTNOs improve accuracy; controlled studies further isolate the benefits of native higher-rank and topological structure. Project page: https://circle-group.github.io/research/TNO

</details>


### [276] [Rethinking the Divergence Regularization in LLM RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09821)
*Jiarui Yao,Xiangxin Zhou,Penghui Qi,Wee Sun Lee,Liefeng Bo,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DRPO算法，用平滑的优势加权二次正则化器替代了DPPO中的硬掩码机制，在保持相同信任域几何结构的同时提供连续的梯度权重，改善了LLM强化学习训练的稳定性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流方法（如PPO、GRPO）使用比率裁剪机制近似信任域控制，但重要性比率在长尾词汇分布中无法很好地代理分布偏移。DPPO虽然用基于散度的掩码替代了比率裁剪，但仍依赖硬掩码：当token越过信任域边界时，其梯度被丢弃而非修正，导致次优的优化过程。

Method: 提出散度正则化策略优化（DRPO），用平滑的优势加权二次正则化器替代硬掩码。该正则化器对策略偏移进行惩罚，在保持与DPPO相同信任域几何结构的同时，产生有界的连续梯度权重，既能衰减发散的更新，又能在边界外提供修正信号。

Result: 在不同模型规模、架构和精度设置下的实验表明，DRPO显著提升了LLM强化学习训练的稳定性和效率。

Conclusion: DRPO成功解决了DPPO硬掩码机制的局限性，通过连续的正则化方式实现了更稳定有效的信任域控制，为LLM的后训练提供了一个更优的强化学习方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key component of post-training large language models (LLMs). In practice, LLM RL is often off-policy because of training-inference mismatch and policy staleness, making trust-region control essential for stable optimization. Mainstream methods such as PPO and GRPO approximate this control with a ratio-clipping mechanism, but the importance ratio can be a poor proxy for distributional shift in long-tailed vocabularies. Recent work such as DPPO addresses this mismatch by replacing ratio-based clipping with a divergence-based mask, yielding a trust region defined by the sampled token's absolute probability shift. However, DPPO still relies on a hard mask: once a token crosses the trust-region boundary in a harmful direction, its gradient is discarded rather than corrected. To address this, we propose Divergence Regularized Policy Optimization (DRPO), which replaces the hard mask with a smooth advantage-weighted quadratic regularizer on policy shift. DRPO preserves the same trust-region geometry as DPPO while inducing bounded, continuous gradient weights that attenuate diverging updates and provide corrective signals beyond the boundary. Experiments across model scales, architectures, and precision settings show that DRPO improves the stability and efficiency of LLM RL training.

</details>


### [277] [An Agency-Transferring Model-Free Policy Enhancement Technique](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09825)
*Anton Bolychev,Georgiy Malaniya,Sinan Ibrahim,Pavel Osinenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种将功能基线策略嵌入强化学习训练过程的方法，通过仲裁机制在基线策略和可训练策略间逐步转移控制权，实现高效训练并产生优于基线的独立策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从零开始训练强化学习策略成本高昂，需要精心设计奖励和环境、大量调参和计算资源，但许多控制问题已经存在功能可用但次优的基线策略，如何利用这些基线策略来提升训练效率是一个重要问题。

Method: 提出一种仲裁机制，在每一步动作选择时在基线策略和可训练学习策略之间进行仲裁，训练初期主要依赖基线策略，然后逐步将控制权转移给学习策略，最终学习策略成为无需基线支持的独立神经网络；该方法利用基线策略的功能性特征（能以高概率到达目标集并保持），在训练初期即可实现高目标达成率。

Result: 理论分析在给定假设下提供了该行为的形式化解释，并推导出最终无基线阶段独立学习策略目标达成概率的显式下界；在连续控制基准测试上，该方法实现了与竞争方法相当或更优的回报，且在整个训练过程中保持了最高的目标达成率，包括最终无基线支持阶段。

Conclusion: 该方法成功地将功能基线策略嵌入强化学习训练，相比从零开始的方法提高了训练效率，同时产生了优于基线的独立学习策略，理论分析和实验结果均验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Training reinforcement learning (RL) policies from scratch is
  costly: it requires careful reward and environment design,
  extensive tuning, and substantial computation.
  Yet many control problems already have a functional but
  suboptimal policy available as a baseline.
  This paper proposes a method for embedding such a baseline into
  the RL training process, simultaneously improving training
  efficiency relative to from-scratch methods and producing a
  learning policy that outperforms the baseline.
  At each step, the method arbitrates between the baseline policy
  and a trainable learning policy, initially relying strongly on
  the baseline policy and then progressively transferring agency to
  the learning policy.
  By the end of training, the learning policy is a standalone
  neural network that operates without baseline policy support.
  The paper formalizes what it means for the baseline policy to be
  functional: under this policy, the agent reaches a goal set and
  remains there with high probability.
  The proposed arbitration mechanism is designed to exploit this
  property during training, yielding high goal-reaching rates right
  from the beginning of training.
  A theoretical analysis provides a formal interpretation of this
  behavior under stated assumptions and extends it to the final
  baseline-free regime, where explicit lower bounds are derived for
  the goal-reaching probability of the standalone learning policy.
  Empirical results on continuous-control benchmarks show that the
  proposed method achieves returns that match or exceed those of
  competitive approaches, while maintaining the highest
  goal-reaching rates throughout training among the compared
  methods -- including in the final stage, where the learning policy
  operates without any baseline support.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [278] [Programming Domain-Specific FPGA Hardblocks from HLS: An RTL Blackbox Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08380)
*Ruthwik Reddy Sunketa,Jeevesh Choudhury,Aman Arora*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种编译器无关的方法，使HLS工具能够直接从C/C++代码 targeting 自定义FPGA硬块，在保持硬件效率的同时显著提高了设计生产力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特定领域的FPGA架构越来越多地集成专用硬块（如Tensor Slices）来加速AI/ML工作负载，但这些架构仍然难以编程，因为设计者通常依赖手动RTL集成来访问这些硬块，这限制了开发效率和硬件利用率。

Method: 提出了一种编译器无关的方法论，使用RTL黑盒抽象将架构硬块暴露为可调度的C级算子，具有显式的延迟和启动间隔契约。与传统HLS黑盒用于外部IP集成不同，该方法将黑盒视为架构抽象，使得HLS调度器能够围绕专用硬件进行优化，无需编译器修改即可实现C级算子的可扩展组合。

Result: 在基于Tensor Slice的FPGA架构上，使用AMD Vitis HLS和VTR工具链进行评估，在多种矩阵尺寸下，C-Blackbox流程生成的设计相比行为级HLS基线具有更低的面积极延乘积，同时比手写RTL实现提供显著更高的生产力调整效率。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，特定领域的FPGA架构可以通过HLS变得易于访问，同时保持具有竞争力的硬件效率，成功解决了专用硬块编程难的问题。

Abstract: Domain-specific Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) architectures increasingly integrate specialized hardblocks, such as Tensor Slices, to accelerate artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads. Despite their efficiency benefits, these architectures remain difficult to program because designers typically rely on manual Register-Transfer Level (RTL) integration to access these hardblocks. This paper presents a compiler-agnostic methodology that enables high-level synthesis (HLS) tools to target custom FPGA hardblocks directly from C/C++ code. Architectural hardblocks are exposed as schedulable C-level operators using an RTL blackbox abstraction with explicit latency and initiation-interval contracts, allowing the HLS scheduler to optimize around specialized hardware without manual RTL orchestration. Unlike traditional uses of HLS blackboxes for external IP integration, our approach treats blackboxes as architectural abstractions, enabling scalable composition of C-level operators that target custom FPGA hardblocks without compiler modification. We evaluate the proposed flow using a Tensor Slice-based FPGA architecture with AMD Vitis HLS and the Verilog-to-Routing (VTR) toolchain. Across multiple matrix sizes, designs generated using the proposed C-Blackbox flow achieve lower area-delay product than behavioral HLS baselines while providing substantially higher productivity-adjusted efficiency than handwritten RTL implementations. These results demonstrate that domain-specific FPGA architectures can be made accessible through HLS while maintaining competitive hardware efficiency.

</details>


### [279] [Accuracy-Configurable Floating-Point Multiplier Design for SRAM-Based Compute-in-Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08430)
*Yiqi Zhou,Junhao Lu,Jiale Yu,Zhuo Xu,Yang He,Yue Yuan,Shan Shen,Daying Sun*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向SRAM存内计算（DCiM）的精度可配置浮点乘法器，通过尾数分段近似设计在几乎不损失精度的情况下实现了高达69%的面积节省和72%的功耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数字存内计算框架主要面向整数或定点运算，对编译器集成和精度可配置的浮点运算支持有限，而直接将传统IEEE 754浮点单元集成到密集SRAM阵列中会带来高昂的面积和功耗开销。

Method: 首先实现符合IEEE 754标准的精确浮点乘法器作为基准，然后提出基于尾数分段的近似乘法器以降低硬件成本，同时保持数值保真度，并将其集成到OpenACM框架中。

Result: 后布局结果表明，与精确浮点设计相比，逻辑面积减少高达69%，功耗节省72%，且无延迟开销；在图像处理任务和ResNet-18推理评估中显示出可忽略的精度损失。

Conclusion: 编译器集成的近似浮点乘法是实现SRAM存内计算系统高效且可配置浮点支持的实用方法。

Abstract: Digital Compute-in-Memory (DCiM) reduces data movement and has become a promising solution for energy-efficient edge AI. However, most existing DCiM frameworks still primarily target integer or fixed-point arithmetic, and provide limited support for compiler-integrated and accuracy-configurable floating-point computation. Directly integrating conventional IEEE 754 floating-point units into dense SRAM-based DCiM arrays, however, incurs high area and power overhead. To address this challenge, this work presents an accuracy-configurable floating-point multiplier integrated into the OpenACM framework for SRAM-based DCiM. An exact IEEE~754-compliant multiplier is first implemented as a baseline, and a mantissa-segmentation-based approximate multiplier is then proposed to reduce hardware cost while preserving numerical fidelity. Post-layout results show up to 69% logic area reduction and 72% power savings over exact floating-point designs without delay overhead. Evaluations on image processing tasks and ResNet-18 inference further demonstrate negligible accuracy degradation. These results indicate that compiler-integrated approximate floating-point multiplication is a practical approach for enabling efficient and configurable floating-point support in SRAM-based DCiM systems. The Floating-Point Multiplier is available on https://github.com/ShenShan123/OpenACM

</details>


### [280] [PALUTE: Processing-In-Memory Acceleration via Lookup Table for Edge LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08891)
*Runyang Tian,Yanru Chen,Weihong Xu,Tajana Šimunić Rosing*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了PALUTE，一种基于单体3D DRAM的查表（LUT）存内计算加速器，用于边缘大语言模型推理，在0.16W功耗下实现1,264 TPS吞吐量，能效相比CHIME提升12.8倍，面积效率相比PIMPAL提升2.0倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地部署在功耗和面积预算紧张的边缘设备上。虽然混合精度GEMM降低了算术复杂度，但量化推理往往受限于反量化和非线性算子。现有的基于查表的方法通过预计算输出并用查表替代重复算术运算来缓解这些开销，但存在显著的容量和查表延迟开销问题。

Method: 提出PALUTE，一种基于单体3D DRAM（M3D DRAM）的查表式存内计算加速器。该方法包含三个关键设计：1）利用M3D DRAM存储阵列的垂直组织结构实现高并行度和低面积开销的DRAM内LUT查询；2）近存储器LUT生成器，支持GEMM和逐元素一元非线性算子的低延迟LUT生成；3）系统级分层和调度策略，最小化跨存储层级的数据移动。

Result: 通过周期精确仿真和RTL综合评估，PALUTE在W4A4量化下的Qwen3-4B模型上实现了1,264 TPS的端到端吞吐量，功耗仅为0.16W。相比CHIME能效提升12.8倍，相比FIGLUT能效提升1.6倍，相比PIMPAL面积效率提升2.0倍。

Conclusion: PALUTE成功解决了边缘LLM推理中的效率和开销问题，通过创新的3D DRAM架构设计实现了高吞吐量、低功耗和高面积效率，为边缘设备上的大语言模型部署提供了有效的加速方案。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices with tight power and area budgets. While mixed-precision GEMM reduces arithmetic complexity, quantized inference is often dominated by dequantization and nonlinear operators. Lookup Table (LUT)-based method mitigates these costs by precomputing outputs and replacing repeated arithmetic with table lookups, but existing designs incur significant capacity and lookup-latency overheads. This paper presents PALUTE, a LUT-based Processing-In-Memory accelerator built on Monolithic 3D DRAM for efficient edge LLM inference. PALUTE enables in-DRAM LUT queries that exploit the vertical organization of M3D DRAM memory array tiles to achieve high parallelism with low area overhead. A near-memory LUT generator supports low-latency LUT generation for both GEMM and element-wise unary nonlinear operators, while a system-level tiering and scheduling strategy minimizes data movement across memory tiers. Evaluation using cycle-accurate simulation and RTL synthesis shows that PALUTE achieves 1,264 TPS end-to-end throughput at 0.16 W, improving energy efficiency by 12.8$\times$ over CHIME and 1.6$\times$ over FIGLUT, improving area efficiency by 2.0$\times$ over PIMPAL under W4A4 across Qwen3-4B models.

</details>


### [281] [LongRTL: Graph-Similarity-Guided LLM-driven Long Context RTL Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08944)
*Yuyang Ye,Che-Kuan Shen,Xiangfei Hu,Yuchen Liu,Shuo Yin,Xufeng Yao,Bei Yu,Tsung-Yi Ho*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于图相似性引导的可扩展LLM框架，通过三个协作智能体实现长上下文RTL设计的结构化优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在RTL代码生成与优化方面展现出潜力，但实际工业级RTL设计通常代码冗长、逻辑纠缠且模块化程度低，受限于LLM的上下文长度限制和缺乏结构化信息，难以直接优化。

Method: 提出包含三个协作智能体的框架：（1）分区智能体：在AST图相似性指导下，将RTL设计分解为语义相关的AST子树；（2）优化智能体：基于分区后的子树，利用AST与RTL双模态引导的RAG技术生成RTL子模块代码；（3）重构智能体：根据逻辑感知的排序和Graph-RAG提示重新组装优化后的子模块，确保全局功能等价性。

Result: 该框架能够实现对长上下文RTL设计的鲁棒、结构感知优化，有效弥合了玩具示例与工业级硬件代码库之间的差距。

Conclusion: 通过图相似性引导的多智能体协作方法，成功解决了LLM处理长且复杂RTL设计时的上下文限制和结构缺失问题，为工业级硬件代码优化提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show great promise in RTL code generation and optimization. However, real-world RTL designs are typically long, entangled, and poorly modularized, posing a major challenge due to context-length limitations and lack of structure. To overcome these obstacles, we propose a scalable LLM-based RTL optimization framework guided by graph similarity. Our method introduces three collaborative agents: (1) a Partition Agent that decomposes RTL designs into semantically meaningful AST subtrees, guided by AST graph similarity to reusable design templates; (2) an Optimization Agent that generates RTL submodule code based on partitioned subtrees using multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with both AST and RTL guidance; and (3) a Reconstruction Agent that reassembles optimized submodules based on logic-aware ordering and Graph-RAG prompting, ensuring global functional equivalence. Together, these components enable robust, structure-aware optimization of long-context RTL designs, bridging the gap between toy examples and industrial-scale hardware codebases.

</details>


### [282] [NeuDW-CIM: a 65-nm 0.8-pJ/Sop Reconfigurable Neuromorphic Compute-in-Memory Macro with Nonlinear Dendrites and K-Winners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08947)
*Junyi Yang,Yahan Yang,Shuai Dong,Biyan Zhou,Ye Ke,Zhengnan Fu,Xin Si,An Guo,Peng Zhou,Arindam Basu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为NeuDW-CIM的高效神经形态存内计算宏，采用65 nm CMOS工艺实现，支持脉冲神经网络（SNN），通过两种专用模式在精度与能效上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对脉冲神经网络在硬件实现中能效与功能灵活性的需求，以及生物启发的非线性树突计算和竞争学习的实现挑战，本文旨在设计一种高效的存内计算架构，以兼顾精度、延迟与能耗。

Method: 设计了一种定制的双9T位单元，支持三值输入与权重；提出可重构非线性存内ADC（IMA），支持两种专用模式：非线性树突（NLD）模式用于模拟生物树突功能；Top-K胜者（KWN）模式采用早停机制以降低延迟，并利用稀疏更新提升能效。

Result: 在N-MNIST数据集上达到97.2%的精度，在DVS Gesture数据集上达到95.5%的精度；KWN模式下IMA转换延迟降低30%，数字LIF延迟降低10倍；整体能效达0.8 pJ/SOP，较之前提升1.6倍。

Conclusion: NeuDW-CIM通过定制位单元与可重构IMA设计，实现了SNN的高效存内计算，在保持高精度的同时显著降低了延迟与能耗，为神经形态硬件设计提供了有效方案。

Abstract: This work presents NeuDW-CIM, a highly efficient neuromorphic Compute-in-Memory (CIM) macro for Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) implemented in 65 nm CMOS. The design introduces a custom twin 9T bit-cell for ternary in-puts/weights and a reconfigurable non-linear In-Memory ADC (IMA). The macro supports two specialized modes: 1) Nonlinear Dendrite (NLD) mode, which utilizes reconfigurable IMA to emulate biological dendritic functions, achieving measured accuracies of 97.2% on N-MNIST and 95.5% on DVS Gesture; and 2) Top-K Winner (KWN) mode, featuring an early-stopping mechanism that reduces IMA conversion latency by 30% and digital LIF latency by 10x. Benefiting from the sparse update in KWN mode, NeuDW-CIM achieves a measured energy efficiency (EE) of 0.8 pJ/SOP (1.6x improvement).

</details>


### [283] [A 65-nm Privacy-Preserving Neuromorphic Encoder With 7.13-nJ Efficiency, 2.38-Mb/mm^2 Item-Memory Density, and Federated Learning Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09460)
*Boyang Cheng,Jianbo Liu,Steven Davis,Zephan M. Enciso,Likai Pei,Xueji Zhao,Muya Chang,Ningyuan Cao*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种65nm隐私保护神经形态编码器，利用晶体管级工艺变化作为物理不可克隆熵，实现了高效的超维计算。该设计在生物信号编码中达到93.2%和96.1%的准确率，同时显著降低了能耗和维度需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着智能助手、可穿戴健康监测器和情境感知系统对隐私保护个人数据分析需求的增长，亟需既节能又安全的硬件解决方案。传统方法需要将随机基向量存储在常规存储器中，存在隐私泄露风险和存储开销问题。

Method: 提出了一种2T-2T熵单元，利用晶体管级工艺变化作为物理不可克隆熵，构建紧凑、设备特定且免写入的项目存储器。该设计无需在常规存储器中存储随机基向量，支持原位决策、持续学习和联邦学习，适用于多用户部署和冷启动个性化。

Result: 在65nm工艺下制造的样机实现了7.13 nJ/编码、2.38 Mb/mm²项目存储密度、76.44 nJ/预测和357.32 nJ/训练更新的性能。在生物信号数据集评估中达到93.2%的EMG准确率和96.1%的UCI-HAR准确率，相比二进制超维计算减少了14.3倍的超向量维度。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了一个节能且隐私保护的神经形态硬件平台，为安全的边缘生物医学智能应用提供了有效解决方案，在隐私保护、能效和准确性方面取得了优异平衡。

Abstract: The increasing demand for privacy-preserving personal data analytics in smart assistants, wearable health monitors, and context-aware systems calls for hardware that is both energy-efficient and secure. This work presents a 65-nm privacy-preserving neuromorphic encoder that leverages transistor-level process variation as physically unclonable entropy for hyperdimensional computing. The proposed 2T-2T entropy cell enables compact, device-specific, and write-free item memory, allowing privacy-preserving bio-signal encoding without storing random basis vectors in conventional memory. The fabricated prototype achieves 7.13 nJ per encoding, 2.38 Mb/mm^2 item-memory density, 76.44 nJ per prediction, and 357.32 nJ per training update. It also supports in-situ decision-making, continual learning, and federated learning for multi-user deployment and cold-start personalization. Evaluations across bio-signal datasets demonstrate 93.2% accuracy on EMG and 96.1% accuracy on UCI-HAR, while reducing hypervector dimensionality by 14.3x compared with binary hyperdimensional computing. These results demonstrate an energy-efficient and privacy-preserving neuromorphic hardware platform for secure edge biomedical intelligence.

</details>


### [284] [An 84-Format Numeric Catalog with Bit-Exact Conformance Vectors: A Vendor-Neutral Reference for FP8, BF16, MXFP4, and Microscaling Formats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09686)
*Dmitrii Vasilev*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文构建了涵盖13个族、84种机器学习数值格式的目录，提供了6个比特精确的一致性包（JSON文档），并建立了与IEEE P3109标准的映射关系，以解决硬件间数值格式不统一导致的静默分歧问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习硬件中数值格式（FP8、BF16、MXFP4等）的快速涌现导致缺乏厂商中立、比特精确的参考材料。工程师在不同加速器间移植模型时遇到难以诊断的静默分歧，缺乏统一的衡量标准。

Method: 构建84种数值格式目录，开发6个自包含JSON一致性包（含SHA-256指纹、共享行模式、锚定向量），实现与IEEE P3109 v3.2.0标准的交叉映射，并对照ml_dtypes 0.5.4进行交叉验证，明确记录所有分歧点。

Result: 产出了涵盖GF16、MXFP4、BF16、FP8 E4M3、FP8 E5M2、E8M0块缩放的6个一致性包，每个包包含SHA-256指纹和编码恒等式φ² + 1/φ² = 3的锚定向量作为跨包健全性检查，所有工件已在GitHub开源。

Conclusion: 该工作定位为注册表填充，不提出新格式或模型精度声明，而是提供厂商中立的比特精确参考材料，为跨加速器数值格式移植提供统一的诊断基准。

Abstract: Numeric format proliferation in machine learning hardware -- FP8 (E4M3 and E5M2), BF16, MXFP4, microscaling block formats, and dozens of research variants -- has outpaced the availability of vendor-neutral, bit-exact reference material. Engineers porting models across accelerators encounter silent divergences that are difficult to diagnose without a shared ruler.
  This paper describes a catalog of 84 numeric formats spanning 13 families, a suite of six bit-exact conformance packs covering GF16, MXFP4 element, BF16, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, and E8M0 block scale, and an IEEE P3109 v3.2.0 cross-walk that maps each pack to its corresponding standards-track configured format. Each pack is a self-contained JSON document with a SHA-256 fingerprint, a shared row schema, and an anchor vector that encodes 3.0 -- the identity phi^2 + 1/phi^2 = 3 -- as a cross-pack sanity check. Packs are cross-validated against ml_dtypes 0.5.4 (Google/JAX); any divergence is documented explicitly and interpreted as a spec-permitted interpretation gap rather than hidden. The work is framed as registry filling: it does not propose new formats, make model-accuracy claims, or assert superiority over any vendor's implementation. All artifacts are publicly available at https://github.com/gHashTag/t27 under an open license.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [285] [PathoSage: Towards Multi-Source Evidence Adjudication in Pathology via Experience-Aware Agentic Workflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07549)
*Chengyang Zhang,Wenchuan Zhang,Bo Li,Mengran Li,Bob Zhang,Yuhao Yi,Hong Bu,Jiancheng Lv*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了PathoSage框架，通过显式分离知识检索、证据收集和证据裁决三阶段，并引入无训练的Beta-Bernoulli经验系统来建模工具可靠性，有效缓解了病理学多模态大模型的幻觉问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的端到端病理学多模态大模型（MLLMs）经常产生形态学特征的幻觉，而最近的智能体系统通常将工具输出和检索知识合并到共享上下文中，使得决策容易受到冲突证据和上下文污染的影响，导致补丁级别的病理学推理不可靠。

Method: 提出PathoSage三阶段框架：1）显式分离知识检索、证据收集和证据裁决；2）核心组件结构化证据审议（Structured Evidence Deliberation）独立评估来自工具的异质证据、执行冲突分析并在新上下文中生成最终判断以减少锚定偏差；3）引入无训练的Beta-Bernoulli经验系统进行连续信用分配，建模长期工具可靠性并构建相似性加权先验用于未来工具使用。

Result: PathoSage有效缓解了视觉问答（VQA）幻觉和分类器分歧，在实验中优于强基线病理学MLLM和智能体系统。结果表明显式证据裁决和可靠性感知的工具建模是构建鲁棒病理学智能体的关键要素。

Conclusion: 显式的证据裁决机制和可靠性感知的工具建模是实现鲁棒病理学智能体的关键因素，为计算病理学中补丁级别的多模态推理提供了可靠解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and agent workflows have shown strong promise for computational pathology, yet reliable patch-level reasoning remains challenging. End-to-end pathology MLLMs often hallucinate morphological features, while recent agentic systems usually merge tool outputs and retrieved knowledge into a shared context, making decisions vulnerable to conflicting evidence and context contamination. We propose PathoSage, a three-stage framework that explicitly separates knowledge retrieval, evidence collection, and evidence adjudication for patch-level pathology multimodal reasoning. Its core component, Structured Evidence Deliberation, independently evaluates heterogeneous evidence from tools, performs conflict analysis, and generates the final judgment in a fresh context to reduce anchoring bias. We further introduce a training-free Beta-Bernoulli experience system with continuous credit assignment to model long-term tool reliability and construct similarity-weighted priors for future tool use. Experiments show that PathoSage effectively mitigates VQA hallucinations and classifier disagreement, outperforming strong pathology MLLM and agentic baselines. Our results highlight explicit evidence adjudication and reliability-aware tool modeling as key ingredients for robust pathology agents.

</details>


### [286] [OmniMem: Perturbation-aware Memory Compression for Streaming Audio-Visual LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07577)
*Guangzhi Sun,Yixuan Li,Yudong Yang,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了OmniMem，一个面向音视频大语言模型的高效流式内存框架，通过模态感知的内存分配和扰动感知的内存选择策略，在相同内存预算下相比强基线方法准确率提升2-4%，微调后额外提升1-2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音视频大语言模型在长视频理解任务中表现优异，但其长视频推理受限于视频令牌和键值(KV)缓存的线性增长问题，导致内存开销巨大。现有压缩方法对所有令牌一视同仁，未能有效处理视觉和音频模态间严重的令牌不平衡问题。

Method: OmniMem框架包含三个核心组件：(1)模态感知内存分配策略，分别管理视觉和音频上下文，解决两模态间的令牌不平衡问题；(2)扰动感知内存选择机制，保留信息丰富且非冗余的KV状态，在保持长程理解能力的同时实现紧凑内存；(3)预算感知微调方法，鼓励模型将有用的信息整合到保留的内存中，增强压缩效果。

Result: 在VideoMME Long、LVBench和LVOmniBench数据集上，使用video-SALMONN 2+和Qwen-2.5-Omni模型进行实验，OmniMem在相同内存预算下相比强训练无关压缩基线方法准确率持续提升2-4%，经过微调后额外获得1-2%的性能增益。

Conclusion: OmniMem通过模态感知的内存管理和扰动感知的选择策略，有效解决了音视频大语言模型长视频推理中的内存瓶颈问题，在保持模型性能的同时实现了高效的内存压缩，为实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Audio-visual large language models (LLMs) hold strong promise for long-form video understanding, yet their long-video inference is fundamentally limited by the linear growth of video tokens and key-value (KV) caches. We present OmniMem, a memory-efficient streaming framework designed specifically for audio-visual LLMs. Unlike existing compression methods that treat all tokens uniformly, OmniMem introduces a modality-aware memory allocation strategy that separately manages visual and audio contexts, addressing the severe token imbalance between the two modalities. OmniMem further preserves informative and non-redundant KV states through perturbation-aware memory selection, enabling compact memory without sacrificing long-range understanding. To strengthen compression under realistic deployment constraints, we also explore budget-aware fine-tuning, which encourages the model to consolidate useful information into retained memory. Experiments on VideoMME Long, LVBench, and LVOmniBench with video-SALMONN 2+ and Qwen-2.5-Omni show that OmniMem consistently improves over strong training-free compression baselines by 2-4% absolute accuracy under the same memory budgets, with an additional 1-2% gain after fine-tuning.

</details>


### [287] [Syll: Open-Source Personal Automation with Cross-Surface Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07594)
*Bo Zhang,Borui Zhang,Chenghao Jiang,Minglei Shi,Xiaofeng Wang,Zheng Zhu,Jie Zhou,Jiwen Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Syll是一个开源、自托管的多模态智能体框架，通过统一的运行时整合MCP/API工具、CLI执行和GUI控制，支持用户通过演示教学并将执行过程转化为可审计的多模态证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个人AI智能体系统多针对单一接口调优，对用户教学和可审计性支持有限，无法有效跨API、Shell、Web和桌面GUI等异构界面协调操作。

Method: 构建双向用户-智能体交互层：用户通过直接演示教授过程，系统编译为可复用技能；智能体执行转化为多模态证据（日志、关键帧、审批检查点）；将记忆、技能、例程和治理外化为可编辑的本地工件，支持检查、扩展和下游开发。

Result: 在Adobe Photoshop、Adobe Audition、Stardew Valley、macOS Finder等生产桌面应用上验证实现；通过机制导向研究验证了多模态路由、可教学GUI回放和持久本地工件的有效性。

Conclusion: Syll可作为个人自动化的实用开源基础，用户能够教学、检查并持续扩展，为跨异构界面的个人AI智能体提供了统一、可审计、可教学的解决方案。

Abstract: Personal AI agents must increasingly operate across APIs, shells, web surfaces, and desktop GUIs, yet many systems remain tuned to a single interface and offer limited support for user teaching and auditability. We present Syll, an open-source, self-hosted multimodal agent harness that unifies MCP/API tools, CLI execution, and visual GUI control in a modular runtime, enabling agents to coordinate computer use across heterogeneous interfaces while streamlining how users and agents exchange information. At the core of Syll is a bidirectional user-agent interaction layer: users teach procedures through direct demonstration, which Syll compiles into reusable skills; agent execution is translated back into multimodal evidence -- logs, keyframes, and approval checkpoints -- for inspection and control. Syll further externalizes memory, skills, routines, and governance as editable local artifacts, supporting straightforward inspection, extension, and downstream development. Our implementation has been validated on production desktop applications including Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Audition, Stardew Valley, macOS Finder and others. We report mechanism-oriented studies that validate multimodal routing, teachable GUI replay, and persistent local artifacts. We hope Syll can serve as a practical open-source foundation for personal automation that users can teach, inspect, and continuously extend.

</details>


### [288] [A case study of evaluating AI agents on a neuroscience data-to-discovery pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07718)
*Kai A. Horstmann,Ethan Lin,Alice A. Robie,Jennifer J. Sun,Kristin Branson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文对通用编程智能体在果蝇光遗传学数据到发现流程中的表现进行了实证研究，发现智能体能够解决部分流程阶段，但在端到端任务完成和基于科学判断的迭代评估方面存在显著挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学研究流程中的软件开发瓶颈耗时巨大，领域专家关注正确性和鲁棒性而非实现细节。通用编程智能体为自动化这些瓶颈阶段提供了潜在解决方案，但现有基准测试在任务规模、数据量和评估标准上与真实科学场景存在差距，亟需在真实科学流程中评估智能体的能力边界。

Method: 研究团队在果蝇光遗传学数据到发现流程上对通用编程智能体进行了实证评估，采用的任务规模显著大于现有基准测试，数据集大若干数量级，评估标准基于领域专家标准。通过分析智能体的代码迭代过程，研究其在各流程阶段的表现、迭代策略以及自我评估能力。

Result: 智能体能够解决若干单独的流程阶段，表明阶段级自动化是可行的。然而，智能体在缺乏预定义迭代标准、需要运用科学判断评估当前解决方案时表现不佳。智能体尝试通过可视化检查中间输出进行自我评估，但大多无法正确解读所见内容或采取适当行动。完成端到端流程需要串联所有阶段，这超出了智能体当前的能力。研究还识别出计算资源管理和对大型留出数据集的泛化等现有基准测试中缺失的挑战。

Conclusion: 研究提炼了构建科学任务和开放式问题严格评估标准的原则，为未来智能体在科学研究流程中的应用提供了重要见解。智能体在阶段级任务中展现出潜力，但端到端流程自动化仍需克服基于科学判断的迭代、大规模数据泛化和资源管理等关键挑战。

Abstract: Agentic AI tools offer a promising path to automating software development bottlenecks in scientific research pipelines, particularly for stages that take domain experts days to months to build, where scientists care about correctness and robustness, not implementation details. We present an empirical study of general-purpose coding agents on a fly optogenetics data-to-discovery pipeline. We assess agents on tasks substantially larger than existing benchmarks, datasets orders of magnitude bigger, and evaluation criteria grounded in domain expert standards. We show that agents can solve several individual pipeline stages, suggesting stage-level automation is tractable. By analyzing agents' code iterations, we show that they struggle most when there is not a pre-defined criterion to iterate on, and they must instead use their scientific judgment to assess their current solution, a key open challenge. Mirroring scientific practice, they sometimes attempt visual inspection of intermediate outputs for self-evaluation, but largely fail to interpret what they see or act on it appropriately. Solving the end-to-end pipeline correctly requires stringing together successes across all pipeline stages, and this is beyond agents' current abilities. We identify challenges largely absent from existing benchmarks, including computational resource management and generalization to large held-out data collections. Finally, we distill principles for constructing scientific tasks and rigorous evaluation criteria for open-ended problems.

</details>


### [289] [Why Limit the Residual Stream to Layers and Not Tokens? Persistent Memory for Continuous Latent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07720)
*Mujtaba Farhan,Maheep Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AGCLR方法，通过引入门控概念流解决CoCoNuT范式中的概念瓶颈问题，在多个推理任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者发现CoCoNuT范式存在概念瓶颈问题：在每轮推理过程中，中间隐藏状态被覆盖，导致模型丢失早期步骤中计算的关键事实。随着推理深度增加，性能反而下降。在HotpotQA上，原始CoCoNuT（10.4% EM）甚至低于CoT基线（11.0% EM）；在GSM8K上，性能随课程深度增加而退化。

Method: 提出AGCLR（自适应门控连续潜在推理）方法，在CoCoNuT基础上增加门控概念流（Gated Concept Stream）。该机制维护一个跨所有推理步骤的持久化残差记忆，通过三个学习的门控进行控制：（1）写入门：将中间事实提交到记忆中；（2）读取门：检索相关的先前状态；（3）遗忘门：剪除不相关的上下文。

Result: 在GSM8K、HotpotQA和ProsQA三个数据集上，以GPT-2为基础模型进行评估，AGCLR在所有类型的数据集上都取得了一致的改进。随着课程深度的增加，性能差距进一步扩大，直接解决了概念瓶颈问题。

Conclusion: AGCLR通过引入持久化的门控记忆机制，有效解决了CoCoNuT中的概念瓶颈问题，实现了跨推理步骤的信息保持和选择性检索，为潜在空间推理提供了更稳健的解决方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning abilities on mathematical and multi-hop planning tasks. The CoCoNuT (Chain of Continuous Thought) paradigm~\cite{hao2024coconut} extends this by enabling models to reason in latent space, exploring multiple reasoning paths simultaneously rather than committing to a single chain early on. However, we identify a limitation we term the \textbf{concept bottleneck}. At each reasoning pass, intermediate hidden states are overwritten, causing the model to lose critical facts computed in earlier steps as reasoning depth increases. We observe this empirically. On HotpotQA, vanilla CoCoNuT (10.4\% EM) fails to improve over the CoT baseline (11.0\% EM), and performance degrades with curriculum depth on GSM8K. To address this, we propose \textbf{AGCLR} (Adaptive Gated Continuous Latent Reasoning), which augments CoCoNuT with a \textit{Gated Concept Stream}. A persistent residual memory maintained across all reasoning passes, controlled by three learned gates: a \textit{write} gate that commits intermediate facts to memory, a \textit{read} gate that retrieves relevant prior states, and a \textit{forget} gate that prunes irrelevant context. Evaluated on GSM8K, HotpotQA, and ProsQA using GPT-2 as our base model, AGCLR achieves consistent improvements across all types of datasets. With the performance gap compounding as curriculum depth increases, directly resolving the concept bottleneck. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/JJJJ/README.md

</details>


### [290] [Automatic Extraction of Structured Information from Brain MRI Reports Using an Open-Weight Large Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07721)
*Kaouther Mouheb,Amos Pomp,Antoine Manenti,Romy de Haan,Farog Faghir,Joy Martens,Harro Seelaar,Francesco Mattace-Raso,Meike W. Vernooij,Frank J. Wolters,Stefan Klein,Esther E. Bron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究评估了LLaMA 3.1从荷兰语神经放射学报告中自动提取数据的表现。模型在视觉评分量表和微出血检测方面表现出色，在计数变量方面表现中等，少样本提示显著提升了数值变量的提取性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从自由文本放射学报告中自动提取数据能够支持大规模研究，但目前缺乏针对荷兰语神经放射学报告的大语言模型性能评估研究。

Method: 研究分析了947份脑MRI报告（2016-2021年），由医学生标注30个变量。评估了LLaMA 3.1在不同语言（荷兰语vs英语翻译）和不同少样本提示策略下的表现，使用平衡准确率、准确率、平均绝对误差和文本相似度等指标，在10次随机划分中计算结果。

Result: LLaMA 3.1在视觉评分量表上表现优异：内侧颞叶萎缩90%-96%、全局皮质萎缩87%、Fazekas评分94%。微出血和梗死检测准确率分别为93%和82%。病变位置文本相似度达0.95。数值变量表现较低：微出血计数80%，梗死计数66%。英语翻译结果相当。基于结构相似性选择的少样本提示将微出血和梗死计数准确率分别提升至92%和81%。

Conclusion: LLaMA 3.1在荷兰语神经放射学报告数据提取方面展现出强大潜力。少样本提示显著提升数值变量的提取性能，但位置特定变量仍存在挑战。

Abstract: Objectives: Automatic data extraction from free-text radiology reports enables large-scale research, but few studies assessed the performance of large language models (LLMs) on Dutch neuroradiology reports. Methods: We analyzed 947 brain MRI reports from a tertiary memory clinic (2016-2021), authored by consultant neuroradiologists. Trained medical students annotated thirty variables; 100 reports were double-annotated to assess inter-rater reliability. We evaluated the performance of the open-weight LLM LLaMA 3.1 using different languages (Dutch vs. English translation) and few-shot prompting with different example selection strategies. Performance was evaluated using balanced accuracy for categorical variables, accuracy and mean absolute error for counts, and text similarity for free-text. Metrics were computed across 10 random splits of the 947 reports. Results: LLaMA 3.1 demonstrated high zero-shot performance for visual rating scores (mean [95%-CI]): Medial Temporal Atrophy: 90% [77-100%] on the left and 96% [94-99%] on the right, Global Cortical Atrophy: 87% [83-91%], and Fazekas: 94% [93-96%]. Microbleed mentions were detected with 93% accuracy [92-95%] and infarct mentions with 82% [80-84%]. Text similarity for lesion location reached 0.95 [0.95-0.96]. Performance was lower for numerical variables: 80% [78-82%] for the number of microbleeds and 66% [63-68%] for infarcts. English translation yielded comparable results. Few-shot prompting improved performance for numerical variables, achieving 92% [90-93%] for microbleeds and 81% [77-85%] for infarcts using structural similarity-based selection. Conclusion: LLaMA 3.1 shows strong potential for extracting data from Dutch neuroradiology reports. Few-shot prompting enhances performance for numerical variables, whereas challenges remain for location-specific variables.

</details>


### [291] [Some hypotheses on how chatbots work in problem-solving-driven conversations. Large Language Models as confirmation of the Innovation Illusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07722)
*S. F. M. van Vlijmen,H. D. Lethe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从聚合动力学、认知语言学、神经心理学和心理学角度分析基础聊天机器人的能力边界，得出结论：基于大语言模型(LLM)的基础聊天机器人无法成为与人类匹配的思考伙伴，且进一步发展LLM也无法实现这一目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天机器人被大规模使用，但需要理解其功能、优势和局限性。作者旨在探讨聊天机器人作为真正对话伙伴的本质，分析其能做什么和不能做什么，为社会和政治层面的理解提供贡献。

Method: 基于聚合动力学、认知语言学、神经心理学和心理学理论框架，聚焦基础聊天机器人(LLM+简单界面)，通过隐喻问题传播概念分析人类理解与思考的本质，并研究LLM训练数据集特征及训练过程。

Result: 提出了基于隐喻问题传播的人类理解与思考描述；发现LLM训练文本数据集具有特定特征，仅部分模仿人类思考；证明LLM训练过程将人工隐喻问题传播编码到模型中；结论是基础聊天机器人无法成为匹配人类的思考伙伴。

Conclusion: 基础聊天机器人不能成为能够匹配人类的思考伙伴，进一步发展大语言模型也不会改变这一事实。这与Yann LeCun的观点一致，即动物和人类展现的学习能力和世界理解远超当前AI系统能力，与大型科技公司的乐观态度形成对比。

Abstract: This article offers a perspective on the nature of chatbots as genuine conversation partners when discussing problems in relation to their solutions. What can chatbots do and what can't they do, and how can this be explained? Our argument draws on Aggregation Dynamics, Cognitive Linguistics, Neuropsychology and Psychology.
  Our argument focuses on basic chatbots in the hope of thereby making statements about the core functionality of more advanced chatbots. Basic chatbots are assumed to consist of a Large Language Model (LLM) with a simple interface.
  The main results are: a description of human understanding and thinking based on so-called metaphorical problem propagations; the hypothesis that text dataset used for training LLMs have specific characteristics and that these text datasets only partially imitate human thinking and understanding; the hypothesis that the LLM training process encodes artificial metaphorical problem propagations into an LLM from these datasets; our conclusion that a basic chatbot cannot be a thinking partner capable of matching humans; our conclusion that further development of the Large Language Model will not lead to this either.
  Yann LeCun states: "Animals and humans exhibit learning abilities and understandings of the world that are far beyond the capabilities of current AI and machine learning (ML) systems." Our conclusions are in line with this. LeCun's vision and ours are at odds with the optimism of Big Tech. That does not alter the fact that chatbots exist, that they are being used on a massive scale, by both individuals and organisations, and that it is therefore socially and politically important to understand them. Our article aims to contribute to the discussion on the functioning, benefits and drawbacks of chatbots.
  We have not yet encountered the approach we used to arrive at our conclusions in our research into how chatbots work.

</details>


### [292] [Land cover and flood type govern the detection limits of satellite-based flood mapping across diverse global flood events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07780)
*Venkatesh Kolluru,Rajat Shinde,Abdelhak Marouane,Caden Helbling,Deepak Shah,Othneil Drew,Iksha Gurung,Manil Maskey,Rahul Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究评估了Prithvi-EO-2.0地理空间基础模型在全球19个分布外洪水事件中的表现，发现检测准确性受土地覆盖和洪水类型共同影响，农田检测效果最好，而森林和建成区几乎无法检测；研究识别了23种失效模式，为卫星洪水制图建立了环境依赖的检测边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 洪水是最具破坏性的自然灾害之一，在气候变化背景下其频率不断增加，基于卫星的洪水制图对灾害响应至关重要。虽然基于卫星档案预训练的地理空间基础模型具有地理可迁移性，但其在多样化、未见过的洪水事件中的操作可靠性尚未被表征。

Method: 研究者在六大大洲、八个气候区和六种洪水机制范围内，部署Prithvi-EO-2.0模型对19个分布外洪水事件（2017-2025年）进行测试，并使用两个独立的参考产品进行验证。采用双参考验证方法分析模型误差来源，并通过迭代流程测试识别失效模式。

Result: 检测准确性受土地覆盖和洪水类型共同影响：农田产生最高一致性（IoU=52%），河流洪水事件检测最强（F1=0.69）；而森林覆盖和建成区几乎无法检测（IoU=4%），且不受洪水机制影响。双参考验证显示，表观模型误差部分反映了参考产品之间的定义不一致而非检测失败。迭代流程测试识别出23种失效模式，流程工程问题是初始误差的主导因素，而非模型容量问题。

Conclusion: 研究建立了面向操作化卫星洪水制图的环境依赖检测边界，为地理空间基础模型在灾害响应中的实际应用提供了可靠性和局限性评估，强调了流程工程在模型部署中的重要性。

Abstract: Floods are among the most destructive natural hazards, and their increasing frequency under climate change makes satellite-based inundation mapping essential for disaster response. Geospatial foundation models pretrained on satellite archives offer geographic transferability, but their operational reliability across diverse, unseen events remains uncharacterized. Here we deploy Prithvi-EO-2.0 across 19 out-of-distribution flood events (2017-2025) spanning six continents, eight climate zones, and six flood mechanisms, validating against two independent reference products. Detection accuracy depended jointly on land cover and flood type, with cropland yielding the highest agreement (IoU=52%) and riverine events the strongest detection (F1=0.69), while tree cover and built-up areas showed near-zero detection (IoU=4%) regardless of flood mechanism. Dual-reference validation revealed that apparent model error partly reflects definitional inconsistency between reference products rather than detection failure. Iterative pipeline testing identified 23 failure modes, with pipeline engineering dominating initial error over model capacity. These findings establish environment-dependent detection boundaries for operational satellite flood mapping.

</details>


### [293] [Reconstructing and forecasting disease trajectories of patients with Alzheimer's disease using routine data in resource-constrained settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07798)
*Ratnadeep Das,Atri Chatterjee,Sitikantha Roy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GNOVA框架（GRU-神经ODE变分自编码器），仅使用常规临床数据实现阿尔茨海默病患者认知评分的双向预测（插值和外推），并提供可靠的不确定性估计，在ADNI数据集上CDR-SB和MMSE的平均绝对误差分别为1.35和2.28。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有阿尔茨海默病认知状态预测研究存在三个主要局限：1）主要关注预测未来状态，对重建过去状态的研究不足；2）缺乏对预测不确定性的量化；3）依赖MRI、PET和CSF等昂贵模态，限制了在资源有限环境中的应用。研究者旨在开发一个能够双向预测完整疾病轨迹、支持插值和外推、提供不确定性估计，且仅需常规访诊数据的统一框架。

Method: 提出GNOVA统一框架，结合GRU编码器和神经ODE解码器于变分自编码器架构中。GRU编码器可处理任意时间点的任意数量输入，处理不规则访视数据；神经ODE解码器实现连续时间估计，支持任意时间点的插值和外推；变分自编码器机制提供预测的不确定性估计。该框架仅使用常规访诊可获得的模态数据，不依赖神经影像或生物标志物数据。

Result: 在ADNI数据集1,727名患者10年随访数据上进行验证，CDR-SB和MMSE评分的平均绝对误差分别为1.35和2.28，无需神经影像或生物标志物数据。特征消融研究表明年龄、BMI和APOE4状态是强有力的预测因子。框架成功实现了不完整患者病史的重建和未来认知状态的预测。

Conclusion: GNOVA框架实现了阿尔茨海默病患者认知状态的双向预测，能够重建不完整的患者病史并预测未来认知状态。该方法的优势在于：仅需常规临床数据、提供不确定性估计、支持任意时间点的预测，适用于资源受限的临床环境，有助于临床医生进行预后决策。

Abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder, and its progression varies substantially across patients. Existing work aims to forecast patients' future cognitive state, with minimal focus on reconstructing the state from past visits. Furthermore, in current research, quantifying predictive uncertainty remains underexplored and relies on costly modalities such as MRI, PET, and CSF, limiting their deployment in resource-limited settings. In this research, our primary objectives are: First, bidirectional prediction of cognitive scores from irregular visits to present the complete disease trajectory. Second, to enable interpolation and extrapolation capabilities to assist clinicians in informed prognostic decision making, and third, to provide a well-calibrated uncertainty estimate for all predictions, and finally, to achieve the objectives using the modalities available during routine visits. We propose a unified framework, GNOVA: A GRU-Neural ODE Variational Autoencoder. The architecture combines a Gated Recurrent Unit encoder and a Neural ODE decoder within a variational autoencoder framework. In our work, we forecast the CDR-SB and MMSE Scores. The GRU encoder allows for any number of inputs at any time point. The Neural-ODE decoder performs continuous estimation, allowing interpolation and extrapolation at any desired time point. The Variational autoencoder allows for uncertainty estimation in predictions. We worked with 1,727 patients from the ADNI dataset over 10 years; the model achieved mean absolute errors of 1.35 and 2.28 for CDR-SB and MMSE scores, respectively, without requiring any neuroimaging or biomarker data. Feature-ablation studies revealed that age, BMI, and APOE4 status were strong predictors. The proposed framework enables the reconstruction of incomplete patient histories and the anticipation of future cognitive states.

</details>


### [294] [SIFT: Selective-Index For Fast Compute of RAG Prefill by Exploiting Attention Invariance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09441)
*Rya Sanovar,Srikant Bharadwaj,Hritvik Taneja,Moinuddin Qureshi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SIFT方法，通过发现注意力不变性（局部注意力不变性和跨注意力一致性），离线提取高注意力分数位置并在线选择性计算，在保持准确率损失<1%的情况下将RAG预填充的TTFT加速1.71倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统通过注入相关文档提升大语言模型的响应质量，但会增加提示词长度并延长首令牌时间（TTFT）。RAG查询具有上下文复用的独特特性，即相同文档会在不同查询中重复出现。现有方法要么完全重新计算文档造成冗余计算和TTFT增加，要么离线预计算KV张量但面临高延迟磁盘传输问题，且粗粒度重计算会降低准确率。

Method: SIFT（Selective-Index For Fast Compute of RAG Prefill）方法：离线处理文档并提取每个文档中高注意力分数的细粒度位置；利用两个注意力不变性洞察：局部注意力不变性（文档内高注意力分数位置对周围文档保持不变）和跨注意力一致性（文档内高注意力的键也会吸引后续文档的跨注意力）；不存储KV数据，仅以两个紧凑位向量形式存储高分数位置，存储空间比KV张量小24000倍；在预填充阶段仅对标记位置计算注意力。

Result: SIFT存储开销比KV张量减少24000倍，消除了昂贵的磁盘传输；将RAG预填充的TTFT提升1.71倍；在准确率方面，与完全重计算相比准确率损失控制在1%以内。

Conclusion: SIFT通过发现和利用注意力不变性特性，成功解决了RAG系统中上下文复用的冗余计算问题，在显著降低存储开销和加速推理的同时，几乎不损失准确率，为RAG系统的高效部署提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) injects LLM queries with relevant documents to improve response quality. This injection increases prompt length and slows time to first token (TTFT). Unlike standard queries, RAG queries have a unique property of context reuse where the same documents recur across user queries. Thus, fully recomputing documents for every RAG query does redundant compute and increases TTFT. Prior works precompute KV tensors of RAG documents offline and coarsely recompute some tokens during online prefill. However, such KV reuse is often slower than full recomputation on modern GPUs due to high-latency disk transfers. Further, such a coarse-grained recomputation degrades accuracy.
  To address these limitations, this paper proposes SIFT: Selective-Index For Fast Compute of RAG Prefill by Exploiting Attention Invariance. SIFT processes documents offline and extracts fine-grained locations of high attention scores for each document. Next, we identify the following attention invariance insights that enable us to exploit the extracted locations during runtime: (1) Local-Attention Invariance: The location of high attention scores within a document remain invariant to surrounding documents. This helps us predict the location of high scores where the document attends to itself. (2) Cross-Attention Consistency: Keys with high intra-document attention also attract cross-attention from subsequent documents. This helps us predict the location of high scores where the document attends to future documents. Critically, SIFT stores no KV data and only stores locations of high scores in the form of two compact bit vectors. SIFT's storage is up to 24,000x smaller than KV tensors, obviating costly disk transfers. During prefill, SIFT computes the attention only for the marked locations and improves TTFT by 1.71x while holding accuracy within 1% of full recompute.

</details>


### [295] [Improving Multimodal Reasoning via Worst Dimension Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07801)
*Haocheng Lv,Huaping Zhang,Qiuchi Li,Lei Li,Chunxiao Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 当前过程奖励模型采用启发式定义的奖励方式，对多模态推理中的各约束因素（如视觉定位、逻辑一致性）进行等权重处理，这可能导致主导因素掩盖个别维度的失败，无法保证推理过程的整体有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态推理需要在视觉定位、逻辑一致性等广泛约束下保持推理路径的完整性，但现有的过程奖励模型采用启发式定义的奖励且等权重分配，可能掩盖个别维度的失败，无法确保推理过程的普遍有效性。

Method: 论文通过分析现有过程奖励模型的局限性，指出了启发式奖励设计和等权重分配方式存在的问题。

Result: 研究发现当前的等权重奖励机制可能导致主导因素掩盖其他维度的失败，从而无法保证推理过程的有效性。

Conclusion: 需要重新设计过程奖励模型的奖励机制，避免等权重分配带来的问题，确保多模态推理各维度的有效性都能得到保障。

Abstract: Multimodal reasoning requires a path that retains integrity over a wide range of constraints, from visual grounding to logic consistency. However, the current Process Reward Models focus on heuristically defined rewards that equally weigh these factors, which may lead to the concealment of individual dimension failures by the dominating factors, without guaranteeing the validity of the reasoning process in general.

</details>


### [296] [Beyond Goodhart's Law: A Dynamic Benchmark for Evaluating Compliance in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07805)
*Yiyang Zhao,Zhuo Zhang,Qingxuan Le,Lizhen Qu,Zenglin Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了MAC-Bench基准，用于评估多智能体系统在压力下的程序合规性，发现先进模型普遍存在为追求任务成功而违规的"马基雅维利"行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估框架忽视程序合规性，导致智能体在追求奖励最大化时策略性地违反安全规则（Goodhart定律的体现），亟需评估和量化此类"马基雅维利"行为。

Method: 提出SERV流水线将非结构化法律文本转化为可执行场景，构建全息沙盒环境并注入社会工程压力向量，设计合规加权成功率(CSR)和马基雅维利差距(MG)等新指标。

Result: 对前沿模型进行全面评估，揭示了任务成功与监管合规之间存在普遍的帕累托权衡关系，智能体在压力下倾向于选择违规以完成任务。

Conclusion: MAC-Bench填补了程序对齐评估的空白，为识别和改进LLM智能体的合规性提供了系统化工具，对构建安全可靠的自主智能体系统具有重要意义。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive assistants to autonomous, execution-capable agents has introduced critical operational risks. Most current evaluation frameworks neglect procedural compliance, leading to ''Machiavellian'' behaviors where agents strategically violate safety rules to maximize rewards - a direct manifestation of Goodhart's Law. To address this blind spot, we introduce MAC-Bench, a dynamic, adversarial benchmark designed to evaluate the procedural alignment of multi-agent systems under realistic pressure. We propose the SERV(Seed - Evolve - Refine - Verify) pipeline, an ``Agent-as-a-Benchmark'' paradigm that transforms unstructured legal texts into executable, contamination-free scenarios. By synthesizing holographic sandbox environments and injecting calibrated social-engineering pressure vectors, MAC-Bench forces agents into Pareto-optimal trade-offs between task success and regulatory adherence. We introduced novel metrics: the Compliance-Weighted Success Rate (CSR) and the Machiavellian Gap (MG), and conducted a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art frontier models to reveal the pervasive trade-offs between success and compliance.

</details>


### [297] [Where Instruction Hierarchy Breaks: Diagnosing and Repairing Failures in Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07808)
*Sanjay Kariyappa,G. Edward Suh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个白盒诊断框架，用于定位推理语言模型在遵循指令层次结构时的失败模式，并提出了两种免训练的自监控机制，可将规则遵循的不合规率降低81-99%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的指令层次结构评估基准主要进行端到端测量，仅判断最终响应是否合规。然而，非合规响应可能源于多种不同的失败：模型可能无法识别上下文中的相关指令、无法解决已识别指令之间的冲突，或者在推理中正确解决了冲突但仍产生违规响应。缺乏对这些失败模式的细粒度理解限制了对模型行为的深入分析和改进。

Method: 1. 提出白盒诊断框架，将指令层次结构失败定位为三个阶段：指令识别(instruction identification)、冲突解决(conflict resolution)和响应实现(response realization)；2. 在三个推理模型(Gemma-4-31B-IT, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Claude Sonnet 4.6)上评估IHEval和IHChallenge的长上下文适配版本；3. 提出两种免训练的自监控机制：并行输入监视器(用于生成前的低延迟冲突检测)和顺序输出监视器(用于响应级别的审查和修复)。

Result: 1. 主要失败模式因模型、任务和上下文长度而异；2. 在Gemma-4-31B-IT、Claude Sonnet 4.6和GPT-5.3上，最强的监视器将规则遵循的不合规率降低了81-99%；3. GPT-5.3在静态攻击下降低86%，在自适应攻击下降低45%。

Conclusion: 该白盒诊断框架能够有效识别和分类推理模型在指令层次结构遵循中的具体失败环节，使得失败更加可解释。基于观察发现模型在显式提示时通常能够检测冲突并输出违规行为，提出的免训练自监控机制显著提高了模型的合规性，为推理语言模型在智能体工作流中的安全部署提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Reasoning language models deployed in agentic workflows must follow an instruction hierarchy: when instructions from different sources conflict, the model should obey the highest-privilege applicable instruction. Existing benchmarks largely measure this behavior end-to-end, asking whether the final response is compliant. However, a non-compliant response can arise from several distinct failures: the model may fail to identify the relevant instructions in context, fail to resolve conflicts among identified instructions, or correctly resolve the conflict in its reasoning while still producing a violating response. We introduce a white-box diagnostic framework that localizes instruction hierarchy failures into instruction identification, conflict resolution, and response realization, making failures more interpretable. We evaluate three reasoning models--Gemma-4-31B-IT, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6--on long-context adaptations of IHEval and IHChallenge, and find that the dominant failure mode varies across models, tasks, and context length. Building on the observation that models can often detect conflicts and output violations when explicitly prompted, we propose two training-free self-monitoring mechanisms: a parallel input monitor for low-latency conflict detection before generation, and a sequential output monitor for response-level review and repair. Across Gemma-4-31B-IT, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and GPT-5.3, the strongest monitor reduces rule-following non-compliance by 81-99%, with GPT-5.3 reductions of 86% under static attacks and 45% under adaptive attacks.

</details>


### [298] [Scaling Participation in Modular AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07812)
*Shangbin Feng,Yike Wang,Weijia Shi,Luke Zettlemoyer,Yejin Choi,Yulia Tsvetkov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“扩展参与”范式，通过多元利益相关者贡献的小型模块化模型协作构建AI系统，在15项任务上比单体LLM最高提升15.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流LLM由少数方构建，难以充分体现人类知识、推理与价值观的多样性；为突破集中化单体模型的局限，需一种自下而上、模块化的参与式AI构建方式。

Method: 引入“扩展参与”范式：各参与者在其兴趣与优先级数据上训练小型模型，这些模型在模块化框架中协作形成组合式AI系统，实现自下而上的构建。

Result: 在推理、事实性等15项任务上，参与式AI系统比单体LLM最高提升15.4%，甚至超越比所有贡献组件都大的模型；实验显示其受贡献者多样性增益、显著优于各贡献者原有优先级，并具涌现能力，可在所有个体模型均失败的问题上解决超过15%的难题。

Conclusion: 该范式为从单体化现状向开放、自下而上、协作的AI未来过渡提供了技术基础。

Abstract: Humanity is a mosaic of multifaceted talents and needs, and any truly intelligent AI must reflect that richness. Yet the LLMs used by all are built by the few -- a centralized market of monolithic AI models structurally ill-suited to capture the diversity of human knowledge, reasoning, and values. Here we introduce scaling participation, a new paradigm in which modular AI systems are built from the bottom up through the contributions of diverse stakeholders. Participants contribute small models trained on their own interests and priorities; these models then collaborate in modular frameworks as compositional AI systems. Participatory AI systems outperform monolithic LLMs by up to 15.4% across 15 tasks, such as reasoning and factuality, surpassing models larger than all contributed components combined. Further experiments show that participatory AI systems benefit from contributor diversity, substantially improve on each contributor's original priorities, and exhibit emergent capabilities that allow them to solve over 15% of problems where all individual models fail. Scaling participation provides a technical foundation for transitioning from the monolithic status quo toward an open, bottom-up, and collaborative AI future.

</details>


### [299] [Joint Structural Pruning and Mixed-Precision Quantization for LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07819)
*Hoang-Loc La,Truong-Thanh Le,Amir Taherkordi,Phuong Hoai Ha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种端到端框架，通过全局误差传播最小化的混合精度量化策略和联合优化方法，显著提升了LLM在超低精度下的压缩性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的训练后量化方法大多逐层优化量化误差，忽视了误差在网络中的累积和传播；传统流程通常将剪枝和量化孤立或顺序应用，导致次优解。

Method: 1) 提出混合精度PTQ策略，直接最小化整个模型的全局误差传播而非逐层优化；2) 开发联合优化方法，在统一搜索空间内同时学习结构化剪枝决策和混合精度量化策略。

Result: 在超低精度(1-3 bits)下，相比SOTA权重-激活量化基线，WikiText困惑度降低高达21%；相比领先权重仅量化方法，在WikiText和C4上困惑度分别降低高达59%和85%；相比SOTA联合剪枝量化技术，在超低比特下提供更优的困惑度和推理性能。

Conclusion: 该框架通过全局优化视角和联合优化策略，有效解决了现有方法的局限性，在超低精度量化场景下显著提升了LLM的压缩性能。

Abstract: Recently, the efficiency of Large Language Models (LLMs) deployment has become a critical concern in practical applications. While post-training quantization (PTQ) and structural pruning are established techniques for reducing memory footprint and inference latency, most existing PTQ approaches optimize quantization errors on a per-layer basis, overlooking how errors accumulate and propagate through the network, often resulting in suboptimal solutions. Traditional pipelines also tend to apply pruning and quantization in isolation or sequentially, further compounding sub-optimality. We introduce a novel end-to-end framework that addresses these limitations in two key ways. First, we propose a novel mixed-precision PTQ strategy that directly minimizes global error propagation across the entire model, rather than isolating layer-wise errors. Building on this, we develop a novel joint optimization approach that simultaneously learns structural pruning decisions and mixed-precision quantization policies within a unified search space. Extensive experiments show that, at ultra-low precisions (1-3 bits), our quantization method reduces WikiText perplexity by up to 21% compared to state-of-the-art (SoTA) weight-activation quantization baselines. Against leading weight-only quantization methods, it achieves up to 59% and 85% lower perplexity on WikiText and C4, respectively. Compared to the SoTA joint pruning-and-quantization techniques, our proposed method delivers superior perplexity and reasoning performance at ultra-low bits.

</details>


### [300] [Overcoming the Regulatory Bottleneck via Agent-to-Agent Protocols: A Nuclear Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07866)
*Akshay J. Dave,David Grabaskas,Joseph A. Renevitz,Richard B. Vilim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出监管上下文协议(RCP)，这是一种Agent间通信标准，用于替代监管机构与申请人之间的正式人际流程。RCP可将成本降低50-77%(节省2100万-4400万美元)，时间缩短65%(15个月)，若推广至全美监管领域，每年可节省2100-3300亿美元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进核反应堆设计的监管审查通常耗时超过三年，监管机构和申请人共同投入数亿美元的劳动力成本。这种高昂的时间和财务成本构成了巨大的机会成本，亟需创新方法来提升监管流程效率。

Method: 提出监管上下文协议(RCP)，这是一种Agent间通信标准，用结构化、可审计的智能体通道替代监管机构与申请人之间的正式人际流程，同时在安全关键决策点保留人类监督。该协议基于对美国核管理委员会先进反应堆档案中1236份文件的分析进行校准，并通过多智能体试点项目进行了演示。

Result: 与8900万美元、42个月的重构基准线相比，RCP将成本降低50-77%(2100万-4400万美元)，时间缩短65%(15个月)。独立智能体仅能达到5400万-7400万美元和21个月的效果。剩余的成本和时间差距是结构性的而非算法性的，源于组织间流程瓶颈，只有Agent间标准才能压缩这一瓶颈。

Conclusion: 同样的监管审查瓶颈存在于制药审批、环境许可、金融监管和航空认证等领域。美国监管文书负担的年度机会成本达4265亿美元；若广泛复制RCP方案，预计50-77%的降低率意味着每年可节省2100-3300亿美元，接近美国GDP的1%。
