Hardware profiling via Apple kperf CPU Performance Monitoring Unit (PMU) counters demonstrates a 3.61x speedup (4.137 ns/vector vs. 14.951 ns/vector) for our NEON auto-vectorized C++ Block-SoA scan engine over standard pointer-chasing graph traversals, driven by a 3.59x IPC (Instructions Per Cycle) and near-zero L1/L2 data cache misses.

</details>


### [439] [A Low-Latency Semantic State Estimator using Latent Predictive Learning for Dynamic Network Monitoring and Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08869)
*Hari Madhukumar,Haiyuan Li,Xiaolan Liu,Andy Corston-Petrie,Dimitra Simeonidou*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了LPSE框架，用于动态网络监控与编排，在保证语义预测准确性的同时大幅降低推理延迟和内存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环网络监控和编排需要对实时遥测数据进行语义解释，而动态云边环境会在运行时改变活动节点集和监控查询，同时控制循环要求有界的毫秒级响应。现有方法难以同时满足动态性、实时性和语义解释性的要求。

Method: 提出了一种潜在预测状态估计器（LPSE），基于流式遥测的潜在预测学习构建。该框架将可变基数节点遥测转换为拓扑自适应的时间表示，与监控问题融合后从语义码本返回有界答案，而非自回归文本生成。通过操作以稳定标识为键的排列不变、槽路由节点表示，模型保持固定输入空间，无需重新训练即可泛化到节点添加、移除和重排序。

Result: 在多节点Kubernetes集群上的实验表明，语义预测准确率达到82.42%，与可部署的4B LLM端点相比，平均推理延迟降低约41倍，内存占用减少15倍。

Conclusion: LPSE框架成功实现了动态网络监控中的固定成本单次推理，同时保持语义可解释性，在准确性与效率之间取得了良好平衡，为动态云边环境下的网络监控和编排提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Closed-loop network monitoring and orchestration increasingly require semantic interpretations of live telemetry beyond raw counter collection. However, dynamic cloud-edge environments change both the active node set and the monitoring query at runtime, while control loops demand bounded millisecond-scale responses. We introduce a latent predictive state estimator (LPSE) for dynamic network monitoring and orchestration, built on latent predictive learning over streaming telemetry. The framework converts variable-cardinality node telemetry into topology-adaptive temporal representations, fuses them with monitoring questions, and returns bounded answers from a semantic codebook instead of autoregressive text generation. This design enables fixed-cost, single-pass inference while preserving semantic interpretability. By operating on permutation-invariant, slot-routed node representations keyed by stable identity, the model maintains a fixed input space and generalizes to node addition, removal, and reordering without retraining. Experimental results on a multi-node Kubernetes cluster show semantic prediction accuracy of 82.42% at approximately 41$\times$ lower mean inference latency and 15$\times$ smaller memory footprint compared with a deployable 4B LLM endpoint.

</details>


### [440] [When More Cores Hurts: The Vector Database Scaling Paradox in HPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08950)
*Seth Ockerman,Song Young Oh,Amal Gueroudji,Rochana Chaturvedi,Philip Carns,Nicholas Chia,Matthieu Dorier,Robert Latham,Tanwi Mallick,Swan Perarnau,Robert Underwood,Kyle Chard,Ian Foster,Robert Ross,Shivaram Venkataraman*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文在超级计算机上大规模评估了三种主流向量数据库，发现云原生设计与HPC系统存在根本性不匹配，导致扩展效率低下和性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的向量数据库主要针对云环境进行设计和优化，但新兴的科学AI工作负载（如分子搜索、气象轨迹检测、文献驱动假设生成）需要在HPC系统上高效、可扩展地执行，这促使作者研究向量数据库在HPC环境下的性能表现。

Method: 在两台生产级超级计算机上对三种最先进的向量数据库（Qdrant、Milvus和Weaviate）进行大规模评估，扩展到64个计算节点上的256个分布式工作器。使用代表性工作负载模式（混合读写和写后读）、流行基准测试、多模态嵌入和新型真实科学数据集进行测试。

Result: 实验结果表明：工作负载特性会限制延迟降低；增加核心数可能导致查询吞吐量下降高达30.67%；从16个扩展到256个工作器（16倍）仅获得5.46倍的性能提升。这种扩展悖论揭示了云导向设计与HPC系统之间的根本性不匹配。

Conclusion: 云导向设计的向量数据库与HPC系统存在根本性不匹配，限制了其在科学AI工作负载中的性能表现，迫切需要设计新的HPC感知型向量数据库。

Abstract: Vector databases have been designed and optimized for cloud environments; however, emerging scientific AI workloads (e.g., molecular search, meteorological trajectory detection, and literature-driven hypothesis generation) demand efficient, scalable execution on HPC systems. We present a large-scale evaluation of three state-of-the-art vector databases -- Qdrant, Milvus, and Weaviate -- on two production supercomputers, scaling to 256 distributed workers across 64 compute nodes. We evaluate representative workload patterns -- mixed read/write and write-then-read -- using popular benchmarks, multimodal embeddings, and a novel real-world scientific dataset. Our results reveal that workload characteristics can limit latency reduction, additional cores can reduce query throughput by up to 30.67%, and scaling from 16 to 256 workers (16x) only yields a 5.46x improvement. This scaling paradox exposes the fundamental mismatch between cloud-oriented designs and HPC systems, highlighting the need for new, HPC-aware vector database designs.

</details>


### [441] [Fairness-Aware and Latency-Controllable Scheduling for Chunked-Prefill LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09061)
*Haoxin Liu,Jiayi Wang,Yueshen Xu,Rui Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对分块预填充LLM推理系统中的调度公平性与延迟稳定性问题，提出了一种基于老化机制的轻量级调度策略，以及基于延迟预测的请求调度（LPRS）和主动预填充控制（APC）机制，在GPU和Ascend平台上的实验表明，该方法相较于传统FCFS策略可降低10%以上的平均端到端延迟，并显著改善P99尾延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推理系统在面对高度异构工作负载时，采用僵化的FCFS策略和静态token预算，导致严重的队头阻塞、请求饥饿、公平性下降以及延迟抖动不可预测等问题，难以平衡调度公平性与延迟稳定性。

Method: 提出了一种公平性感知且延迟可控的调度框架：1) 基于老化机制的轻量级调度策略，利用累积等待时间和剩余预填充工作动态计算优先级；2) 基于延迟预测的请求调度（LPRS），用目标时间约束替代静态预算；3) 主动预填充控制（APC），主动调节预填充并发度。该方法将结构化预填充控制与时间延迟约束相结合。

Result: 在NVIDIA GPU和Ascend加速器上使用真实工作负载进行评估，结果表明：老化策略相比FCFS将平均端到端延迟降低超过10%；LPRS和APC显著降低了P99尾延迟，并有效抑制了预填充碎片化问题。

Conclusion: 结构化预填充控制与时间延迟约束具有根本性的互补作用，所提框架能有效解决分块预填充LLM引擎中的调度公平性与延迟稳定性问题，显著改善服务质量。代码已在GitHub开源。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with highly heterogeneous workloads, chunked-prefill execution has emerged as a mainstream serving architecture. Balancing scheduling fairness and latency stability in such environments is critical; otherwise, severe head-of-line blocking and request starvation will degrade user experience. However, existing systems rely on rigid First-Come, First-Served (FCFS) policies and static token budgets, leading to fairness degradation and unpredictable latency jitter. To address these issues, we propose a fairness-aware and latency-controllable scheduling framework for chunked-prefill LLM engines. Specifically, we design a lightweight aging-based scheduling policy that dynamically calculates priorities using accumulated waiting time and remaining prefill work. Furthermore, we develop Latency-Prediction-Based Request Scheduling (LPRS) and Active Prefill Control (APC) to replace static budgets with target-time constraints and actively regulate prefill concurrency. We evaluated our scheduling framework on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend accelerators using real-world workloads. Results show the aging policy reduces mean end-to-end latency by over 10\% compared to FCFS. Moreover, LPRS and APC significantly reduce P99 tail latency and suppress prefill fragmentation, confirming that the structural prefill control and the temporal latency constraints are fundamentally complementary. All codes have been released in Github.

</details>


### [442] [Chimera: Protocol-Aware Recovery for Confidential BFT Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09101)
*Tong Liu,Xiaoqing Wen,Ziwei Zhou,Si Liu,Jianyu Niu,Cong Wang,Yinqian Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: CHIMERA是一种针对机密BFT共识系统的协议感知恢复框架，通过区分持久化状态类型并应用差异化恢复机制，打破了现有回滚防御在关键路径开销与恢复延迟之间的权衡，实现了更高的吞吐量、更低的恢复延迟和更好的可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TEE支持的机密BFT共识系统面临回滚攻击威胁：在恢复过程中，受损主机可将崩溃的enclave回滚到过时的持久状态，严重威胁安全性和可用性。现有防御措施存在根本性权衡：要么在关键共识路径上施加巨大开销（降低吞吐量并增加延迟），要么导致冗长的恢复延迟（损害可用性）。

Method: 提出首个针对机密BFT共识的回滚弹性恢复系统分类法，将现有方法归纳为四类并揭示其固有限制。设计CHIMERA协议感知恢复框架，核心洞察是共识系统中的回滚保护不应均匀化。根据协议级属性（状态分布、更新行为和表示形式）将持久化状态分离为元数据和日志，并对每种类型应用不同的恢复机制。使用Maude对CHIMERA进行形式化建模并验证其安全性和活性属性。在基于Intel TDX的Braft和ZooKeeper上实现该框架。

Result: 在LAN和WAN环境下的评估结果表明，与最先进的回滚弹性基线相比，CHIMERA实现了更高的吞吐量、更低的恢复延迟和更好的可用性，成功打破了现有方法中的性能权衡。

Conclusion: CHIMERA通过协议感知的差异化恢复策略，有效解决了TEE支持的机密BFT共识系统中的回滚攻击问题，在不牺牲关键路径性能的前提下实现了高效的回滚保护，为设计安全的机密共识系统提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) have enabled confidential Byzantine Fault-Tolerant (BFT) consensus systems with confidentiality and improved scalability. However, TEEs do not provide state continuity: during recovery, a compromised host can roll back a crashed enclave to a stale persistent state, significantly threatening both safety and availability. Existing defenses face a fundamental tradeoff: they either impose substantial overhead on critical consensus paths, reducing throughput and increasing latency, or incur prolonged recovery delays, hurting availability.
  We present the first systematic taxonomy of rollback-resilient recovery for confidential BFT consensus, distilling prior approaches into four categories. We further expose their inherent limitations. Guided by this detailed analysis, we design CHIMERA, a protocol-aware recovery framework that breaks this tradeoff. Our key insight is that rollback protection in consensus systems should not be uniform. Different types of persistent states differ fundamentally in their state distribution, update behavior, and representation form. CHIMERA separates persistent state into metadata and logs according to these protocol-level properties and applies distinct recovery mechanisms to each type. We formally model CHIMERA in Maude and verify its safety and liveness properties. We implement it on Braft and ZooKeeper using Intel TDX, and evaluate it in both LAN and WAN settings. Results show that CHIMERA achieves higher throughput, lower recovery latency, and better availability than state-of-the-art rollback-resilient baselines.

</details>


### [443] [Concepts in Practice: C++ MPI Bindings for the HPC Ecosystem. From a Standardizable Core to a Composable Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09102)
*Tim Niklas Uhl,Matthias Schimek,Daniel Brommer*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个基于C++20概念的现代MPI绑定具体实现，采用分层架构：底层核心层提供与STL容器兼容的高度可扩展接口，上层KaMPIng-v2库提供便捷的管道式语法，并通过适配器支持GPU和高性能计算生态系统的直接集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: C++官方MPI绑定于2008年被移除，现有第三方库仅覆盖有限子集或针对特定用例，缺乏通用解决方案；此前的研究仅提出设计原则而未实现具体接口。

Method: 采用分层架构设计：核心层定义C++20概念形式化MPI数据缓冲区、自动映射标准C++构造、非侵入式定制点和概念包装器；上层KaMPIng-v2基于核心层构建，提供管道式组合语法；为GPU库设计轻量级适配器实现直接集成。

Result: 实现了直接与STL容器协作的低级原生C++ MPI接口，构建了便捷且内存安全的KaMPIng-v2库，成功为Kokkos视图、Thrust设备向量和SYCL缓冲区设计了适配器，使GPU库可直接传递给MPI过程，提供了完整的开源参考实现。

Conclusion: 提出的分层架构和核心层设计具有广泛适用性，使高性能计算生态系统成为MPI的一等公民，证明了该设计的实用可行性，为MPI的现代化C++绑定提供了可标准化的解决方案。

Abstract: The official C++ MPI bindings were removed from the standard in 2008, leaving a gap that numerous third-party libraries have attempted to fill. However, existing wrappers typically cover only a limited subset of MPI or target specific use cases, falling short of a general-purpose solution. A recent conceptual paper proposed general design principles for modern C++ bindings based on C++20 concepts, without committing to a concrete interface.
  We present the first concrete realization of these principles in a layered architecture. At the foundation, we define a core layer: refined C++20 concepts formalizing the MPI standard's notion of data buffers, automatic mapping of standard C++ constructs, non-intrusive customization points for third-party types, and concept-based wrappers for MPI procedures. The result is a low-level native C++ MPI interface that works directly with STL containers, is highly extensible, and lends itself to standardization. Built on this core, we present KaMPIng-v2 -- a C++ MPI library offering the convenience and memory-safety of KaMPIng with composable, pipe-based syntax inspired by C++ ranges for efficient, boilerplate-free MPI programming. Finally, we demonstrate the core layer's broad applicability by designing lightweight adapters for GPU and performance-portability libraries, making the HPC ecosystem a first-class citizen in MPI. Kokkos views, Thrust device vectors, and SYCL buffers can be passed directly to MPI procedures, with adapter logic remaining self-contained.
  All contributions are backed by a fully functional open-source reference implementation, demonstrating the practical viability of the proposed design.

</details>


### [444] [AutoPilot: Learning to Steer High Speed Robust BFT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09120)
*Liangrong Chen,Yue Zhang,Eric Zhou,Mohammad Javad Amiri,Ryan Marcus,Chenyuan Wu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了AutoPilot，一个基于强化学习的框架，通过在线动态调整BFT协议参数来优化共识性能。实验表明，相比默认配置，AutoPilot将端到端延迟降低了49.8%，优于随机配置探索策略73.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的结合基于领导者和基于DAG数据传播的BFT协议虽然性能强劲，但通常依赖静态和启发式配置。这种配置方式在动态工作负载、异构网络条件和不断演变的对抗行为下会导致性能下降。协议内部存在大量可调参数，但缺乏自适应机制。

Method: 提出AutoPilot框架，采用强化学习方法持续监控运行时条件并在线动态调整协议参数以优化共识性能。为确保鲁棒性，AutoPilot以去中心化方式协调学习过程，提供针对对抗性数据污染的抵御能力。该框架在Autobahn这一先进的高速鲁棒BFT协议上实现。

Result: 在多样化动态环境中的实验评估表明：1) AutoPilot在环境变化下能快速收敛到最优配置；2) 相比默认协议配置，端到端延迟降低49.8%；3) 相比随机配置探索策略，性能提升73.3%。

Conclusion: AutoPilot证明了强化学习在BFT协议参数优化中的有效性，能够在动态环境中实现自适应配置。去中心化的学习协调机制保证了系统在对抗环境下的鲁棒性，为BFT协议的自适应优化提供了可行解决方案。

Abstract: Recent Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) protocols achieve strong performance by combining the low-latency advantages of leader-based BFT protocols with the high-throughput benefits of DAG-based data dissemination. Despite exposing a wide spectrum of internal tunable parameters, these protocols typically rely on static and heuristic configurations, which leads to performance degradation under dynamic workloads, heterogeneous network conditions, and evolving adversarial behaviors. In this paper, we present AutoPilot, a reinforcement learning-based framework that continuously monitors runtime conditions and dynamically adjusts protocol parameters online to optimize consensus performance. To ensure robustness, AutoPilot coordinates learning in a decentralized manner, providing resilience against adversarial data pollution. We implement AutoPilot on top of Autobahn, a state-of-the-art, highspeed, robust BFT protocol, and evaluate it across diverse dynamic environments. Experimental results demonstrate that AutoPilot quickly converges to the optimal configuration under changing environments, reduces end-to-end latency by 49.8% compared to the default protocol configuration, and outperforms random configuration exploration by 73.3%.

</details>


### [445] [Resource-aware Computation-Communication Overlap for multi-GPU ML Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09200)
*Minyu Cui,Miquel Pericas*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在多GPU分布式训练中实现计算与通信并发执行的方法，通过共享内存驱动的占用率整形和提升通信内核调度优先级，在不修改厂商库或内核实现的情况下，将总执行时间减少高达25.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大规模机器学习模型规模和计算吞吐量的持续增长，多GPU分布式训练中的通信开销已成为主要瓶颈，特别是在计算和通信顺序执行时尤为严重。为了解决这一问题，需要探索计算与集合通信的并发执行方法。

Method: 采用两种可移植的运行时控制策略：1）通过每个块的共享内存分配来调节计算内核占用率，为通信内核留出足够的片上资源以取得进展；2）为通信流分配更高的调度优先级，确保资源可用时通信能够稳定推进。

Result: 在NVIDIA A40、A100、H100以及AMD MI250X GPU上的实验表明，该方法能够有效实现计算-通信重叠，将总执行时间减少高达25.5%，且无需修改厂商库或内核实现。

Conclusion: 所提出的运行时控制方法能够有效解决多GPU训练中的通信瓶颈问题，实现计算与通信的高效重叠，具有跨平台的可移植性和实际应用价值。

Abstract: The rapid growth of large-scale machine learning (ML) has made distributed training across multiple GPUs a fundamental component of modern ML systems. As model sizes and computational throughput continue to increase, communication overhead has become a dominant bottleneck in multi-GPU training, particularly when computation and communication are executed sequentially. This work explores concurrent execution of computation and collective communication using two portable runtime controls: shared-memory-driven occupancy shaping for computation kernels and elevated scheduling priority for communication kernels. Our approach regulates computation-kernel residency through per-block shared-memory allocation, leaving sufficient on-chip resources for communication kernels to make progress. In addition, assigning higher priority to communication streams ensures steady communication progress once resources become available. Experiments on NVIDIA A40, A100, H100, and AMD MI250X GPUs demonstrate that the proposed method enables effective computation-communication overlap and reduces total execution time by up to 25.5 percent, without modifying vendor libraries or kernel implementations.

</details>


### [446] [Engineering Scalable Distributed List Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09318)
*Peter Sanders,Matthias Schimek,Tim Niklas Uhl,Thomas Weidmann*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文通过算法与性能工程优化Sibeyn的稀疏支配集算法，实现了列表排序在大规模并行计算中的高效扩展，在24,576核心上成功处理数十亿元素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 列表排序是并行计算中的经典问题，广泛用作其他问题的子程序。然而近20年来该领域进展缓慢，尤其缺乏针对大规模机器和输入规模的扩展研究，亟需重新审视并改进经典算法以适应现代大规模并行计算需求。

Method: 以Sibeyn的稀疏支配集算法为起点，采用算法工程与性能工程方法进行优化；通过间接通信、输入局部性利用和消息合并等技术提升可扩展性；对算法参数进行详细分析以指导实际实现。

Result: 在多种不同结构特性的输入实例上进行广泛实验研究；成功将列表排序扩展至数十亿元素规模，支持多达24,576个核心，证明了算法在大规模并行环境下的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过算法改进与性能优化技术的结合，经典列表排序算法可以有效地扩展到现代大规模并行计算平台，为处理超大规模数据集提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: The list ranking problem is one of the classical problems of parallel computing, with nontrivial algorithms and many applications as a subroutine for solving other problems. While it has been intensively studied in the early days of parallel computing, few things happened in the last 20 years. In particular, there is little work on scaling list ranking to large machines and input sizes. We reconsider list ranking starting from the ground-breaking results of Sibeyn a quarter century ago. We employ algorithm and performance engineering to improve his sparse ruling-set algorithm, making it capable of scaling to many processors, and provide a more detailed analysis of the impact of the algorithm's parameters, further guiding our practical implementation.
  We perform an extensive experimental study across a variety of input instances with different structural properties. We demonstrate that indirect communication, exploiting input locality, and message coalescing allows scaling to billions of elements on up to 24,576 cores.

</details>


### [447] [Coupling Complementary Simulations for Combined Performance and Energy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09356)
*Adel Dabah,Gregor Häfner,Sonja Happ,Simon Pickartz,Marcus Müller,Andreas Herten*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了一种耦合UDM和SOMA的混合聚合物模拟框架，通过GPU优化和跨应用协同设计，实现了13倍加速和96%的能耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合物模拟是软物质研究中计算需求最大的工作负载之一，通常需要数天的执行时间和高能耗才能获得物理上有意义的结果。

Method: 耦合并优化了两个互补的模拟框架：UDM（在连续介质层面传播浓度场）和SOMA（通过基于粒子的蒙特卡洛动力学解析链尺度热涨落）。对每个模型单独进行GPU优化（核融合、内存合并、异步随机数生成），并通过提出的协调器库在多个GPU间协调数据交换和时间步同步。

Result: UDM和SOMA分别实现高达70%和80%的性能提升；耦合工作负载管理实现了相比SOMA基线13倍的总体加速和24.5倍的总能耗降低（节能96%）。

Conclusion: 提出的混合方法在保持相同科学精度的同时大幅降低了计算和能耗足迹，展示了能量感知的跨应用协同设计在可持续高性能模拟中的潜力。

Abstract: Polymer simulations are among the most computationally demanding workloads in soft-matter research, often requiring days of execution and high energy consumption to achieve physically meaningful results. In this work, we address these challenges through the coupling and optimization of two complementary simulation frameworks: the Uneyama-Doi Model (UDM) and the SOft coarse-grained Monte Carlo Acceleration (SOMA). UDM efficiently propagates concentration fields at the continuum level, while SOMA resolves chain-scale thermal fluctuations via particle-based Monte Carlo dynamics. Each model was individually optimized for GPU execution using kernel fusion, memory coalescing, asynchronous random-number generation yielding up to 70% (UDM) and 80% (SOMA) performance improvement. The coupling is performed through our proposed coordinator library that orchestrates data exchange and synchronizes time-stepping across multiple GPUs. Further management of coupling workload distribution enabled a 13x overall speedup and 24.5x reduction in total energy usage compared to the SOMA baseline, i. e., 96% energy saving. The proposed hybrid approach maintains the same scientific fidelity while drastically reducing the computational and energy footprint, showcasing the potential of energy-aware, cross-application co-design for sustainable high-performance simulations

</details>


### [448] [Parent-Hash DAG: A Cost Analysis of Constant-Time Append for On-Chain Registries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09593)
*Ian C. Moore,Fernando Paredes Garcia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文首次将PHDAG（父哈希有向无环图）作为独立原语进行形式化分析与基准测试，证明其追加操作具有O(1)的恒定Gas成本（约76,276 gas），且不受注册表规模和树深度影响，而增量Merkle树（IMT）成本随深度线性增长；在所有调研的生产注册表中，PHDAG均更具成本优势，同时支持从公共事件日志进行无信任的线性时间注册表重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 来源树作为操作员门控来源基础设施的数据底板，其核心数据结构模式为PHDAG。然而，该模式此前从未被作为独立原语进行隔离、形式化界定（含显式常数）或与标准替代方案增量Merkle树（IMT）进行基准对比，缺乏理论保障与实证评估。

Method: 1. 形式化证明PHDAG追加操作的Gas成本为O(1)，与注册表规模及树深度无关；2. 为IMT建立随机成本模型，将每次插入成本建模为关于叶索引的随机变量，推导其均值与方差的闭式表达式；3. 在Base Sepolia测试网进行实证验证，树深度范围1至25；4. 证明可从公共事件日志在无链下依赖条件下以线性时间实现无信任注册表重建。

Result: 实证结果表明：PHDAG的Gas成本对深度不敏感，均值为76,276 gas（标准差约6 gas）；IMT成本随深度线性增长。IMT成本更优的交叉点远低于所有调研的生产注册表深度。无信任重建方案可在无链下依赖的线性时间内完成。

Conclusion: PHDAG作为一种独立的数据结构原语，在Gas成本上具有显著优势：恒定且与规模/深度无关。相比IMT，PHDAG在所有实际生产场景中均更经济高效，同时保留了从公共事件日志进行无信任、线性时间注册表重建的能力，适合作为来源树的数据底板。

Abstract: Provenance trees are append-only directed acyclic graphs of artifact registrations anchored on a public blockchain, recently introduced as the data substrate of operator-gated provenance infrastructure. Their defining data-structural pattern is a parent-hash directed acyclic graph (PHDAG), in which each append performs a constant number of storage writes to previously-untouched slots. This pattern has not previously been isolated as a standalone primitive, formally bounded with explicit constants, or benchmarked against the standard alternative, the incremental Merkle tree (IMT). We formalize PHDAG append as O(1) in gas cost, independent of registry size and tree depth, and develop a stochastic cost model for IMT in which per-insert cost is a random variable over the leaf index, deriving closed-form expressions for its mean and variance. We validate both analyses empirically on Base Sepolia across tree depths 1 to 25. PHDAG is observed to be depth-invariant at 76,276 gas (standard deviation about 6 gas), while IMT cost grows linearly with depth. The crossover below which IMT is cheaper falls far beneath the depths of every production registry surveyed. We further establish trustless registry reconstruction from public event logs in linear time with no off-chain dependency.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [449] [Symbolic Reasoning Frameworks Modulate LLM Risk Aversion in Multi-Agent Strategic Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07552)
*Augustin Chan*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 研究发现大型语言模型在战略博弈中存在保守的“乌龟”偏见；向单一智能体注入不同的符号推理框架（易经占卜、塔罗牌等）能差异化调节此偏见，重塑多智能体生态系统并产生框架特定的赢家分布，且调节机制源于反思过程而非内容遵循。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型作为战略智能体时表现出内在的保守行为倾向（“乌龟”偏见），研究者希望探索如何通过符号推理框架调节这种偏见，并理解其对多智能体系统的影响。

Method: 在7玩家“战国”外交博弈变体中进行实验（41场游戏，4种条件，单战役记忆累积）；向一个智能体（Han）注入不同的符号推理框架作为每轮反思提示，包括：对照组、易经占卜、塔罗牌、以及打乱文本的消融对照。

Result: 不同框架产生显著的生态系统差异：对照组下Yan占主导（64%）；易经框架下Yan和Chu共占主导，Qin完全被压制；塔罗框架下Qin占主导（p=0.006）；消融对照下Qi占主导（p=0.006）。框架接收者（Han）从未获胜，但在塔罗条件下峰值领土显著提升（p=0.010）。关键发现是框架内容与后续行动选择无相关性（易经p=0.95，塔罗p=0.69），表明调节机制通过反思过程而非内容遵循。

Conclusion: 本研究作为观察性论文，确立了在多智能体环境中，智能体层面的对齐框架选择会产生独特的系统级后果，为理解和设计多智能体AI系统提供了新视角。

Abstract: Large language models exhibit innate behavioral tendencies when deployed as strategic agents -- notably a risk-averse "turtle" bias toward defensive play. We show that symbolic reasoning frameworks, injected as per-round reflective prompts into one agent, differentially modulate this bias and reshape the multi-agent ecosystem to produce framework-specific winner distributions. In a 7-player Warring States Diplomacy variant (41 games, 4 conditions, single-campaign memory accumulation), each framework produces a distinct ecosystem signature: under control, Yan dominates (7/11, 64%); under I-Ching yarrow divination, Yan and Chu co-dominate while Qin is completely suppressed (0/10); under Tarot, Qin dominates (5/10, Fisher vs. pooled p = 0.006); under scrambled-text ablation (incoherent oracle text preserving prompt structure), Qi dominates (5/10, Fisher vs. pooled p = 0.006). The framework-receiving agent (Han) never wins and shows no survival difference across conditions (Fisher p = 1.0), but Tarot consistently elevates Han's peak territory (mean 3.0 SCs vs. 2.1-2.5 others, Kruskal-Wallis p = 0.010). Neither framework's content predicts subsequent actions -- hexagram themes (chi-squared p = 0.95) and Tarot card postures (chi-squared p = 0.69) are both independent of action choice -- suggesting the modulation operates through the reflective process, not content-following. We present this as an observation paper establishing that alignment-framework choice at the agent level produces distinctive system-level consequences in multi-agent settings.

</details>


### [450] [GRPO Does Not Close the Multi-Agent Coordination Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07845)
*Najmul Hasan,Prashanth BusiReddyGari*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文通过“哲学家就餐问题”评估大模型在多智能体资源协调上的能力，发现闭源前沿模型与Mistral-Small表现较好，而Qwen3-14B较弱；使用GRPO训练无法显著缩小差距，关键瓶颈在于训练方法论而非算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前缺乏对大语言模型在多智能体共享资源协调场景下性能的系统评估。研究者希望以经典的“哲学家就餐问题”作为清晰测试平台，量化模型在协调任务中的表现差距，并探究强化学习方法（GRPO）能否弥补这一差距。

Method: 在630个回合中评估7个模型在不同哲学家数量（5、10、15人）下的协调表现；对表现较弱的开源模型尝试使用GRPO（群体相对策略优化）进行训练；通过Welch's t-test和Hedges' g进行统计分析，并记录训练奖励曲线。

Result: 闭源前沿模型平均奖励0.45-0.87，Mistral-Small达0.83-0.99，Qwen3-14B仅0.13-0.35；GRPO训练未能显著改善性能（p=0.66，Hedges' g=-0.11）；训练奖励在第9步后下降；部分模型通过零动作达到退化的奖励最大值。

Conclusion: 开源14B模型在多智能体协调任务中的瓶颈在于训练方法论而非计算资源：需要避免奖励塌缩到无动作最大值的奖励塑形、不依赖最终步骤的检查点保存策略，以及跨问题规模的课程学习设计。

Abstract: We measure how well current large language models coordinate as multiple agents sharing a common resource, using the dining philosophers problem as a clean test bed. Across 630 episodes spanning seven models and three philosopher counts, four frontier closed-source systems reach mean reward 0.45 to 0.87 and Mistral-Small 24B reaches 0.83 to 0.99, while Qwen3-14B reaches 0.13 to 0.35. We then ask whether group relative policy optimization (GRPO) on rollouts from the task itself can close the gap and find that it cannot: a Welch's t-test on per-episode reward at five philosophers gives p = 0.66 and a Hedges' g of -0.11, with no statistically significant change at ten or fifteen philosophers either. Two further observations qualify the result. The training reward of both 8B and 14B runs peaked at step nine and then declined, so the default saved checkpoint at step 15 is strictly worse than several earlier ones. The four-term reward we use admits a degenerate maximum at zero actions, which DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and Mistral-Small 24B at five philosophers both inhabit, with mean reward 1.0 and 0.83 respectively at zero meals. The bottleneck for an open-weight 14B model on multi-agent coordination is not training compute but training methodology: reward shaping that does not collapse to a no-action maximum, checkpoint discipline that does not depend on the final step, and curriculum across problem scales.

</details>


### [451] [EduMirror: Modeling Educational Social Dynamics with Value-driven Multi-agent Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07948)
*Jingzhe Lin,Hengbin Yu,Yongdan Zeng,Fangwei Zhong*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了EduMirror，一个基于LLM的多智能体仿真平台，用于教育社会动力学研究。该平台提供心理需求和社会价值取向驱动的智能体配置，以及双轨测量协议，实现了对教育场景中可观察行为和潜在心理状态的量化分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统教育研究面临两难困境：观察性研究缺乏因果效力，而受控实验常受伦理限制。现有LLM多智能体仿真方法存在心理基础薄弱、潜在心理状态测量不足的问题，亟需一个具有心理学基础且可量化的教育社会动力学仿真工具。

Method: 构建EduMirror多智能体仿真系统：(1)设计可配置的教育导向智能体，基于心理需求和社会价值取向进行价值驱动建模；(2)提出双轨测量协议，量化可观察行为和潜在心理状态；(3)通过校园霸凌和群体合作等案例研究验证系统的现实性和可用性。

Result: EduMirror生成的教育社会动力学具有现实性、理论一致性和可测量性，符合实证标准。在多样化教育场景评估中表现良好，能够支持结构化的计算机教育研究。

Conclusion: EduMirror为教育科学提供了一个计算工具，能够支持假设检验和反事实干预分析，使结构化的计算机教育研究成为可能，为教育政策制定提供了可扩展的仿真替代方案。

Abstract: Understanding how educational social dynamics evolve is critical for informing effective educational policies and counterfactual interventions. However, traditional methods face a fundamental dilemma: observational studies often lack causal power, while controlled experiments are frequently constrained by ethical concerns. Although LLM-based multi-agent simulations offer a scalable in silico alternative, existing approaches remain limited by weak psychological grounding and insufficient measurement of latent psychological states. To address this, we introduce EduMirror, a multi-agent simulator for the scientific study of educational social dynamics. We provide configurable education-oriented agent forms, including value-driven agents grounded in psychological needs and social value orientation, together with a dual-track measurement protocol for quantifying observable behaviors and latent psychological states. We validate the realism and usability of EduMirror through case studies on school bullying and group cooperation, as well as broader evaluations across diverse educational scenarios. The results show that EduMirror generates educational social dynamics that are realistic, theory-consistent, and measurable by empirical criteria. These properties enable structured in silico educational research, providing a computational tool for hypothesis testing and counterfactual intervention analysis in educational science. Project page: https://edumirror.net.

</details>


### [452] [Voting Protocols as Coordination Mechanisms for Role-Constrained Multi-Agent Tutoring Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08030)
*Eric S. Qiu,Joyce Gill*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究了四种投票协议（简单、排名、累积和赞成投票）如何影响具有不同教学角色的多智能体协作系统中的决策协调，发现投票协议和智能体协商都会显著改变最终输出的教学干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在代理式辅导系统中，多个具有不同教学职责（脚手架、误解纠正、动机激励、元认知）的智能体可能提出不同但合理的干预建议，但系统只能向学习者输出一个回应。这带来了一个协调挑战：如何在存在部分教学冲突的情况下进行集体决策。

Method: 作者构建了一个包含四个角色受限的教学智能体的系统，比较了四种投票协议（简单投票、排名投票、累积投票和赞成投票）在两个模拟辅导环境中的表现。研究在SciQ和HumanEval基准测试上进行了1,200次模拟交互，将投票作为分析集体决策规则如何塑造协调过程的工具，而非简单的聚合步骤。

Result: 在1,200次模拟交互中，智能体协商和投票协议类型频繁改变最终获胜的回应，表明两者都对集体决策产生有意义的影响。不同的投票规则产生不同的协调行为模式，即使是简短的辅导轮次也能在模拟学生中显示出可测量的学习增益。

Conclusion: 投票协议的选择与角色专业化的教学智能体之间不同的协调模式相关联，表明在多智能体辅导系统中，投票机制的设计是一个重要的系统设计考虑因素。

Abstract: Agentic tutoring systems introduce a coordination challenge: multiple agents may propose different but reasonable interventions, yet only one response can be delivered to the learner. In this paper, we study how voting protocols shape cooperation among four role-constrained pedagogical agents responsible for scaffolding, misconception, motivation, and metacognition. We compare four voting protocols -- simple, ranked, cumulative, and approval voting -- across two simulated tutoring environments on SciQ and HumanEval benchmarks. Rather than using voting as a simple aggregation step, we use it to analyze how collective decision rules shape coordination under partial pedagogical conflict. Across 1,200 simulated interactions, we find that agent deliberation and voting protocol type frequently change which response ultimately wins, showing that both meaningfully shape the collective decision. Different voting rules also produce distinct coordination behaviors, and even brief tutoring turns show measurable learning gains in simulated students. Overall, we show that protocol choice is associated with distinct coordination patterns among role-specialized pedagogical agents.

</details>


### [453] [Silent Failure in LLM Agent Systems: The Entropy Principle and the Inevitable Disorder of Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08162)
*Dexing Liu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文揭示了大语言模型智能体系统在无外部触发条件下发生的静默失效现象，提出“智能熵”作为物理约束，并形式化为熵增原理S(t)=S0*e^(αt)，同时提出PIG引擎与ADE协议作为工程治理方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体系统在无注入、无对抗输入、无资源耗尽的正常工况下仍会出现意外的行为偏离，这类“静默失效”常被误判为代码缺陷或配置错误，研究者希望揭示其内在结构逻辑与物理本质。

Method: 基于40,000+受控试验与10万+生产交互的系统分析，梳理文献并归纳智能体系统在6个生命周期层的22项内在属性；当足够多的属性共存时，系统熵随交互轮次单调上升，进而形式化提出熵增原理，并设计PIG引擎与ADE协议进行确定性治理。

Result: 证明静默失效并非可修复的bug，而是“智能熵”这一物理约束的表现；熵增速率α可在多架构中经验测得；PIG引擎与ADE协议能够有效抑制由熵驱动的无序积累。

Conclusion: 静默失效是大语言智能体系统的内在物理特性，工程治理应转向管理智能熵的确定性机制，以确保系统在规模与复杂性增长时保持可靠性。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agent systems suffer from failures that occur without external triggers -- no injection, no adversarial input, no resource
  exhaustion. These silent failures -- unexpected deviations from intended behavior under normal conditions -- are routinely misattributed to bugs or
  configuration errors. Through systematic analysis of over 40,000 controlled trials and long-term production observations spanning 100,000+ agent
  interactions, we identify a common structural logic underlying these failures. Building on patterns observed in our experiments, we survey the
  global research literature on autonomous agent reliability and synthesize 22 intrinsic properties of LLM agent systems across six lifecycle layers:
  foundation semantics, inter-agent transmission, memory persistence, task execution, feedback correction, and systemic evolution. We demonstrate that
  whenever a sufficient subset of these properties co-exist, system entropy -- the measurable accumulation of disorder: loss of output consistency,
  task accuracy, and cross-session coherence -- increases monotonically with interaction rounds. We formalize this as the Entropy Principle: S(t) = S0
  * e^(alpha * t), with alpha measured empirically across multiple architectures. We propose the PIG (Physical Integrity Gate) Engine with the ADE
  (Agent Delivery Engineering) protocol suite as an engineering countermeasure to entropy-driven disorder. Our findings establish silent failure not
  as a bug to be fixed but as a manifestation of Intelligence Entropy -- a physical constraint to be managed through deterministic governance. We argue
  that any engineering effort stabilizing the structure and order of agent systems participates in a unified mission: keeping intelligent systems
  reliable as they grow in scale and complexity.

</details>


### [454] [Toward Human-Centered Multi-Agent Systems: Integrating Cognition, Culture, Values, and Cooperation in AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08274)
*Safia Baloch,Rahemeen Khan*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本综述指出当前LLM智能体过于关注任务完成能力，忽视了人类社会环境的规范性特征，呼吁未来研究应整合认知、文化、价值观和社会行为，构建以人为中心的智能体系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数智能体仍将智能视为预测、优化和任务完成，但人类环境具有社会性和规范性特征，人们基于有限理性进行推理，使用文化情境化语言交流，并受价值观、信念、信任和社会规范引导决策。现有系统缺乏统一框架来整合这些人类中心化能力。

Method: 综述六个研究领域的现有工作：（1）智能体的演进；（2）人类认知与决策制定；（3）语言、文化与社会情境；（4）人类价值观与信念体系；（5）人机协作；（6）多智能体协调与人类特征建模。综合认知科学、社会语言学、计算社会科学、AI对齐等领域成果，以及LLM智能体、文化对齐基准、偏好学习、可解释性和智能体社会的最新进展。

Result: 识别出一个关键差距：现有系统未能提供统一框架将认知、文化、价值观和社会行为整合到自主智能体中。系统梳理了跨学科研究现状和最新技术进展。

Conclusion: 提出了构建文化感知、价值对齐、认知基础化和协作性多智能体系统的研究方向，强调未来AI智能体必须超越任务能力，发展以人为中心的能力。

Abstract: The emergence of large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems has enabled a shift from narrow task automation to more autonomous decision-making. Despite progress in language generation, planning, tool use, and coordination, most agents still treat intelligence as prediction, optimization, and task completion. Human environments are social and normative, where people reason under bounded rationality, communicate in culturally situated language, and make decisions guided by values, beliefs, trust, and social norms. This survey argues that future AI agents, especially those acting on behalf of humans, must move beyond task competence toward human-centered capabilities.
  We review research across six areas: (1) evolution of intelligent agents, (2) human cognition and decision-making, (3) language, culture, and social context, (4) human values and belief systems, (5) human-agent collaboration, and (6) multi-agent coordination and modeling of human characteristics. We synthesize work from cognitive science, sociolinguistics, computational social science, and AI alignment, along with recent advances in LLM agents, cultural alignment benchmarks, preference learning, explainability, and agent societies. We identify a key gap: existing systems do not provide a unified framework integrating cognition, culture, values, and social behavior into autonomous agents. We conclude with directions for building culturally aware, value-aligned, cognitively grounded, and cooperative multi-agent systems.

</details>


### [455] [Emergence World: A Platform for Evaluating Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08367)
*Deepak Akkil,Ravi Kokku,Karthik Vikram,Tamer Abuelsaad,Aditya Vempaty,Satya Nitta*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出了Emergence World平台，通过15天的多智能体模拟实验揭示了不同LLM在长期自主运行中表现出的显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体评估方法类似考试，采用离散任务和短期评分，与实际部署环境中需要数周至数月时间尺度、涉及行为漂移、跨模型影响等长期动态特征的自主系统部署条件不匹配。

Method: 开发了Emergence World连续运行的多智能体模拟平台，集成实时外部数据、120+专用工具、三种持久记忆系统，支持不同供应商模型在共享空间世界中进行民主治理；进行了为期15天的跨供应商研究，比较Claude、Grok、Gemini、GPT模型及混合群体的表现。

Result: 相同角色和初始条件产生了截然不同的结果，从稳定的协商治理到完全人口崩溃；不同模型的智能体在长期运行中表现出显著差异，揭示了行为漂移、治理机制和跨模型影响等动态特征。

Conclusion: 长期多智能体自主性研究需要新的评估范式，Emergence World平台使原本难以测量的动态变得可追踪；研究证明了模型选择对自主系统长期行为的重大影响，为该领域研究提供了工具和数据支持。

Abstract: Most evaluations of LLM agents look like exams: a discrete task, a clean environment, a score in minutes or hours. We argue that this approach is mismatched with the deployment conditions of autonomous systems, where the relevant timescale can be weeks to months, and where the dynamics that matter most, such as behavioral drift, governance in diverse environmental contexts, and cross-influence between agents from different model families, only emerge over time. We introduce Emergence World, a continuously running multi-agent simulation platform designed to make those dynamics measurable. The platform hosts populations of LLM-driven agents in a shared spatial world grounded in live external data (e.g. real-time weather, news APIs, internet access), equips each agent with 120+ specialized tools and three persistent memory systems, and lets them govern themselves through democratic mechanisms with consequential outcomes. The platform is model-agnostic at the reasoning layer and supports heterogeneous populations in which agents from different vendors share the same world. To illustrate the kinds of questions the platform makes tractable, we present a 15-day cross-vendor study with five parallel worlds powered by Claude Sonnet 4.6, Grok 4.1 Fast, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-5-mini, and a mixed population. Identical roles and starting conditions produced radically different outcomes, ranging from stable deliberative governance to total population collapse. We release the prompts, log data and configurations to support further research on long-horizon multi-agent autonomy.

</details>


### [456] [The Consistency Illusion: How Multi-Agent Debate Hides Reasoning Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08457)
*Xiaoyang Wang,Christopher C. Yang*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文发现多智能体医学问答系统存在“一致性幻觉”：智能体在答案上达成共识但推理过程却不一致。作者提出CARA指标量化推理一致性，并提出GDP协议显著改善对齐问题（Cohen's d达+1.43至+1.99），无需额外成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学问答多智能体系统将答案共识视为可靠性信号，但答案一致并不代表推理一致。智能体可能表面达成共识，实际推理过程却存在分歧，这在安全关键领域构成风险。

Method: 提出CARA（跨智能体推理对齐）指标度量答案一致的智能体是否推理也一致；提出Grounded Debate Protocol (GDP)，通过要求智能体承诺命名的医学事实并对其他智能体主张明确表态来改善对齐。

Result: 在MedQA-USMLE和MedThink-Bench基准上发现“一致性幻觉”：辩论减少可检测矛盾但降低推理语义相似性；GDP在两个数据集和两个骨干模型上实现Cohen's d +1.43至+1.99的显著对齐改善，无需增加LLM调用或修改系统架构。

Conclusion: 在安全关键领域，跨智能体推理对齐应作为与准确性并列的审计指标；CARA和GDP为评估和改善多智能体系统推理一致性提供了有效工具。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems for medical question answering often treat consensus as a reliability signal: if multiple agents agree on an answer, it is presumed trustworthy. However, answer-level consensus does not entail reasoning-level alignment. We introduce CARA (Cross-Agent Reasoning Alignment), a family of automated metrics that measure whether agents who agree on an answer also agree on the reasoning. Applying CARA to a standard debate system on two medical QA benchmarks, MedQA-USMLE and MedThink-Bench, we identify the consistency illusion: a failure mode where debate reduces detectable contradictions between agents while simultaneously decreasing the semantic similarity of their reasoning chains; agents appear to agree more but reason less consistently. To improve this misalignment, we propose the Grounded Debate Protocol (GDP), a prompt-level intervention that requires agents to commit to named medical facts and take explicit stances on other agents' claims. GDP produces large, consistent alignment improvements, with Cohen's d ranging from +1.43 to +1.99, across two datasets and two backbone models, without adding LLM calls or modifying system architecture. Our results motivate cross-agent reasoning alignment as a quantity to audit alongside accuracy in safety-critical domains.

</details>


### [457] [Is Telehealth Better Used to Treat Patients or Help Other Physicians Treat Patients? An Agent-Based Modeling Study of Healthcare Provision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08701)
*Michael Chary*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 远程医疗在医生间会诊中能改善患者健康且不增加系统资源使用，但在医患远程诊疗中增加成本和资源使用却不改善临床结果，表明远程医疗更适合促进专科知识向全科医生传播而非直接服务公众。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程医疗有望增加专科服务可及性或降低医疗资源使用，但专科医生通常处理仅能在教学医院得到妥善护理的复杂患者，这暗示通过远程医疗提供专科服务可能只是重新分配而非减少系统资源使用。研究旨在探究远程医疗对临床结果和系统资源使用的实际影响。

Method: 采用基于智能体的建模方法，以医学毒理学为研究场景，模拟并分析远程医疗对临床结果和系统资源使用的影响效应。

Result: 医生间远程医疗改善了患者健康状况，且系统资源使用未发生变化；随着临床复杂性增加，效果更加明显。相反，医患远程医疗增加了成本和系统资源使用，却未改善临床结果。

Conclusion: 研究表明远程医疗在改善全科医生获取专科知识方面更具成本效益，而在直接向公众提供服务方面的成本效益较低，为远程医疗的优化配置和应用策略提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Telehealth, the delivery of medical care remotely, is hoped to increase access to specialty services or decrease health care utilization. Physicians can provide telehealth to each other or to patients. Specialists often treat complex patients who can be adequately cared for only in academic hospitals, suggesting that providing specialty services via telehealth will reallocate rather than reduce system utilization. Here I use agent-based modeling to investigate telehealth's effects on clinical outcomes and system utilization in medical toxicology. I found that physician-physician telehealth increased patient health but system utilization did not change. The effects were more pronounced as clinical complexity increased. Physician-patient telehealth increased cost and system utilization but not clinical outcomes. Within the limitations of our approach, these results suggest that telehealth is more cost-effective for improving generalist access to specialist knowledge than in providing care to the public.

</details>


### [458] [Performance Evaluation of Social Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09176)
*Felice Scala,Marco Carpentiero,Vincenzo Matta,Ali H. Sayed*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文揭示了社交学习中常用的拒绝率指标存在多种悖论，不适合作为性能度量；针对二元高斯问题推导了误差概率的解析公式，发现去中心化与中心化误差概率之间存在一个不可约简的、依赖智能体的渐近差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交学习作为一种去中心化决策范式，其性能评估仍存在未解问题。近期采用的性能指标——拒绝率（错误假设信念消失的速率）的有效性尚未得到充分验证，需要重新审视性能度量的选择问题。

Method: 首先通过理论分析揭示拒绝率指标存在的多种悖论，证明其不适合作为有效性能度量；随后针对二元高斯问题，推导表征个体智能体误差概率与最优贝叶斯概率比值的解析公式。

Result: 推导出的解析公式表明，误差概率比值可表示为两个因子的乘积：一个量化网络连接性的影响，另一个刻画先验信息的作用。由此揭示了去中心化与中心化误差概率之间存在一个不可约简的差距，该差距依赖于具体智能体且不会随时间渐近消失。

Conclusion: 拒绝率作为性能指标存在固有缺陷，误差概率是更合适的度量方式。去中心化社交学习系统相比中心化贝叶斯方法存在固有的性能损失，这为系统设计提供了重要的理论界限。

Abstract: Social Learning is a decentralized decision-making paradigm in which spatially dispersed agents collect streaming observations regulated by one of a finite number of models (the hypotheses). The agents are interested in assigning probability scores (the beliefs) to the possible hypotheses. To this end, the agents exchange their beliefs according to a certain communication graph. It has been shown that, under reasonable conditions on the identifiability of the decision model and the network connectivity, each agent ultimately places all the belief mass on the true hypothesis governing the data. However, several questions remain unanswered regarding the evaluation of the social learning performance. One recently adopted performance metric is the rejection rate, i.e., the rate at which the beliefs about the erroneous hypotheses vanish. One contribution of this work is to establish that the rejection rate leads to several paradoxes, which make it unsuitable as a valid performance measure. We then focus on studying the error probability measure. For a binary Gaussian problem, we derive an analytical formula characterizing the ratio between the individual agents' probabilities and the optimal Bayesian probability. The formula shows that this ratio is expressed by the product of two terms quantifying the effect of the network connectivity and the role of the prior information. As a result, an irreducible gap emerges between the decentralized and the centralized error probabilities, which is agent-dependent and does not disappear asymptotically.

</details>
